tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bka' srung dang bcas pa'i byon tshul legs par bshad pa chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu dges par byed pa'i yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan+saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya mahā aṃ bhu ta a ts+tshan+ni karma wa ti ya na mā mi/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po rmad byung mi chad pa'i 'phrin las can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis shing rta la chibs nas/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga ldan grogs su legs byon pa'i/ /lha mi'i 'dren pa mnyam med zas gtsang sras po zhes/ /yongs grags 'jig rten mchod 'os kun gyi bla ma rgyal/ /gang gi gsung rab lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /bshad dang bsgrub pa'i sgo nas 'phags yul dang / /bod yul mun pa'i gling kun gsal mdzad pa'i/ /paṇa grub lo chen thams cad phyag gi gnas/ /sngon gyi sprul pa'i rgyal po tho tho ri/ /phyag na pad+mo srong btsan sgam po dang / /zur phud lnga pa gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i gar/ /khri srong lde'u btsan zhabs la lan brgyar 'dud/ /sa dbang gang gi yan lag mchog gi khrir/ /zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po nyer bkod pa'i/ /bod 'dir bstan rtsa 'dul khrims gtsang ma'i sgo/ /dang por 'byed mdzad bo dhi satwa rgyal/ /gang gi mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje yis/ /grangs med bdud dpung tshogs kun tshar bcad ste/ /stobs ldan dregs byed thams cad bran 'khol ba'i/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' drin bsam bzhin dad/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab gzugs/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid gzhan ngor mi yi zol/ /lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung brgyud las byon pa'i/ /sa skya'i bla chen brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' rin chen zhes/

/rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar bsam yas khyod cig bsngags/ /skyes chen gang gi rgyal tshab thugs kyi sras/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag he ru ka /gzhan ngor ngur smrig gos dang gos dkar gyi/ /na bzas mdzes pa 'jam dbyangs sku mched rgyal/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs bud+dha'i mtshan/ /gang thugs ye shes ngo bor ro gcig pa'i/ /yi dam zhi khro chos skyong nor lhar bcas/ /skyabs gnas bslu med rnams la gus btud nas/ /kha ba ri pa'i bsod nams zhing gi mchog /rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs pa'i gzhal med khang / /bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /gtsug lag khang dang de yi bka' srung gi /byon tshul gsal bar bshad pa'i legs bshad gtam/ /'di ni chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs/ /mnyes par byed pa'i lha yi rol mo ste/ /de la brten nas dgos 'dod kun 'byung phyir/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir ngas bshad kyi/ /don gnyer skal bzang dpyod ldan slob bu'i tshogs/ /tshul 'di mkhas mang 'dus pa'i do ra ru/ /rang gzhan mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du long / /zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas nas/ 'dir dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bka' srung dang bcas pa'i byon tshul legs par bshad pa chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu dges par byed pa'i yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ spyir gtsug lag khang dang srung ma rnams kyi byon tshul bshad pa/ bye brag bka' srung mchog 'di byon tshul/ de las 'phros pa'i skabs su babs pa'i don gzhan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bod yul 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa byung ba'i tshul ni/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/

/zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ rje la snga ba gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun pa lha tho tho ri snyan zhal gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin te/ de yang chos rgyal de nyid pho brang yum bu lha mkhar na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de'i pho brang gi steng du rin po che'i sgrom bu zhig babs pa kha phye bas gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa/ tsin+dha ma ṇi'i gzungs/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo/ dpa' skong phyag rgya pa rnams byung / gang yin ngo ma mkhyen kyang yid du 'ong bas ming gnyan po gsang bar btags te/ de la phyag mchod byas pas rgyal srid mnga' thang cher rgyas/ rgyal po yang gzhon sha can du gyur te dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga thub zer ro/ /de yang rgya gar gyi chos rgyal mya ngan med gnyis pas ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten dang glegs bam bye ba bzhengs/ de'i rab gnas kyi skabs mchod rten dang glegs bam 'ga' zhig rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la btags te mchod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dang / bod du bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis mthun pa'i rlung chen po g.yos nas mkha' la btegs te pho brang gi rtse la babs pa yin zhes kha cig las bshad la/ mkhas pa la la ni/ gzhan dag nam mkha' las babs zer ba bon po nam mkha' la dga' bas bon gtam yin/ don la paṇ+ḍi ta blo sems mtsho dang / lo tsā ba mi the ses de rnams khyer nas bod la 'ong ba rgyal po la phul bas/ yi ge yang mi shes/ don yang ma go bas/ lo paṇa gnyis phyir log dgos pa byung ba yin no zhes 'dod la/ gang ltar de la bstan pa dbu brnyes ba zhes zer ro/ /de nas rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par sprul pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su bod mun pa'i dmag rum 'dra ba la/ lha sa dang / tha 'dul dang / yang 'dul la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur/

bal yul nas jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang / byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ rang byung tsan+dan gyi jo mo sgrol ma/ rgya nag nas jo bo shākya mu ne spyan drangs pa sogs kyi sgo nas dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod/ de nyid dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa ni chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan nyid yin te/ 'di ni sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yin zhing / 'di'i ring la dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa yin te/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ de yang rgyal po'i dbang po gcig tu sprul nas mnga' 'og tu bsdus ste/ sems can gyi don rgya che ba dang / bod kha ba can gyi don byed nus par dgongs nas/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pas/ bod yul gyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan bya ba'i bka' 'og na 'dug par gzigs so/ /der rgyal po khri lde gtsug btsan dang / gyim shang kong jo gnyis pho brang brag dmar na rin po che'i khri steng na gzim nas bzhugs pa la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer sna lnga'i sna la gser gyi khyi'u chung ngu mtshon gang pa gcig gyim shang kong jo'i mngal du spros nas zhugs pa la/ de yang yum gyi mnal lam na shar phyogs nas 'od nyi ma shar ba lta bu gcig byung nas mngal du zhugs par rmi/ tshul de lta bu yab rgyal po la smras pas/ bar snang gi lha bran gcig rang re'i bur yong ba yin te yong gsungs/ rmi lam de shin tu bzang ngo gsungs te yab rgyal po shin tu dgyes so/ /de nas yum lus mi bde ba gang yang med pa/ 'gul ba dang / 'phar ba dang / 'khrig pa la sogs pa byung ba dang / shes pa gsal ba dang / lus yang la bde ba dang / nyon mongs pa mi skye bar gyur to/ /de nas zla ba dgu ngo dang bcu na pho brang brag dmar du yum la gnod pa med par sras khri srong lde'u btsan sku bltams so/

/de yang tshems dung so khor mor yod pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing g.yas su 'khyil ba/ shin tu mdzes pa lha'i sras lta bu zhig rta'i lo dpyid zla ra ba'i skar ma rgyal gyi nam langs nyi ma shar ba la sku 'khrungs so/ /mtshan khri srong lde'u btsan du gsol/ de nas rgyal bu dgung lo lnga lon pa la/ sna nam pa'i zhang khrom pa skyes dang / sna nam pa rnams rgyal bu khri srong lde'u btsan nged kyi tsha bo yin zer nas/ rgya mo la dbang che byas rgyal bu 'phrog tu byung pa las/ der rgyal blon kun nyi ma gcig tshogs nas dga' ston chen po byas te/ rgyal sras rgyal bu la khyed kyi ma rgya mo yin nam/ sna nam pa'i sras yin ngos 'dzin bcug pa las/ sras rgyal bu khri srong lde'u btsan na re/ gral rim gyis phyag g.yas gdengs te/ khri srong lde'u btsan rgya tsha la/ /sna nam zhang gi ci zhig bgyi/ /zhes gral rim gyis bsgrags so/ /de nas rig pa'i gnas thams cad mkhyen zhing / dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa na/ yab khri lde gtsug btsan sku 'das nas dgung du gshegs so/ /sras rgyal bu khri srong lde'u btsan rgyal sar mnga' gsol te jo mo gsum khab tu bzhes pa ni/ tshe spong za me tog sgrol/ pho yongs za rgyal mo btsun dang / 'brom za byang chub sman dang gsum mo/ /de nas lo bdun 'bangs dang / so tshigs phyi'i so kha bsrung ba dang / nang gi so tshigs 'dzin zhing rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /de nas lo nyi shu glang gi lo la dam pa'i chos bya ba'i thugs dgongs skyes te/ sngon gyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos kyang / bod mtha' 'khob kyi yul 'dir dam pa'i chos mang po bsgyur/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa sogs dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod nas bod la bka' drin shin tu che ba mdzad 'dug pas/ da ni ngas kyang bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa zhig cis kyang bya dgos pa 'dug pas/ de yang thog mar dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang gi rten 'gro ba mi rnams kyi mos pa byed pa'i sa/

rgyal po nga rang gi thugs dam lha khang zhig bzhengs dgos par dgongs kyang / blon po rnams gdug pa che zhing chos la shin tu gnag pa las/ de la thabs 'khos ji lta bu'i sgo nas mdzad pa ni/ rgyal blon thams cad dga' ston rgya chen po byas te/ sngon rgyal mes dbon rnam gnyis kyis mdzad srol las stabs ji ltar byas pa la gleng ste las stabs ji ltar bya ba dang / rgyal khrims chos khrims ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lugs gleng pa las/ rgyal pos blon rnams la 'dam kha btang pa/ shar ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i rtse mor shel gyi mkhar zhang po rgya'i yul mthong ba gcig brtsig gam dang gcig g.yas ru gtsang po zangs kyi sbubs su 'jug gam dang gnyis/ ngam gshod kyi bye ma bres 'jal lam dang gsum/ has po ri zangs kyi phur nas gzer thams cad kyi mgo nang du bstan pa byed dam dang bzhi/ 'bal mo grog po gser gyi 'gengs sam dang lnga/ yom 'bog gi thang la lha khang pa ru tsam zhig bzhengs sam dang drug 'dam kha btang pa la/ blon po rnams chos la gnag cing lha khang dkon mchog gi rten bzhengs par mi spro mod kyi/ gzhan rnams mi 'grub pa'i stobs kyi lha khang brtsig par 'cham mo/ de nas btsad po dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig lon pa stag gi lo la rmang bting par bzhed de/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na slob dpon bo dhi satwa zhes bya ba byung chub sems dpa' mkhyen pa che ba gcig yod par grags nas/ bsnyags dz+nyā na ku mas bya ba'i lo tsā mkhas pa de la gser bre gang bskur/ g.yog po gnyis dang / bang chen pa mi gsum btang nas spyan drangs pas/ bod kyi btsad po dang tshe snga ma'i 'brel yod pas 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ bod du byon nas mjal ba dang / de la rgyal pos 'di skad zhus pa/ slob dpon lags/ bdag rang gi g.yar dam dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang gi rten/ 'gro ba mi rnams kyi mos pa byed pa'i sa/ gtsug lag khang gcig bzhengs pa legs pas/

dbyibs gling bzhi gling phran ri rab lcags ri dang bcas pa gcig la dpe blangs nas bzhengs bsam pa ji ltar legs sam/ zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi gsung las/ dpal brag dmar bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa 'dzam bu gling na byin rlabs che ba gcig byed pas/ mdo sde/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa ste mtshan nyid kyi sde thams cad dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde thams cad dang mthun zhing mi 'gal ba 'gran gyi do med cig bgyid 'tshal gsungs/ de nas rgyal pos mkhan po rin po ches de ltar mkhyen lags sam zhus pas/ ngas cis kyang shes te/ de lta bu cig o tan+ta pu ri na yang yod pa ngas mthong / de la o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang zhes kyang grags 'dug gsungs pas/ de nas rgyal pos 'o na cis kyang legs 'dug pas de ci 'dra zhig yod zhus pas/ rgyal po rang legs par gson cig ngas bshad kyi/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon gyi dus su mu stegs rigs 'dzin gyi sgrub pa po cig yod pa des ro sgrub byed pa la/ dngos grub len pa la sgrub g.yog mtshan rtags dang ldan pa kun du btsal bas ma brnyed pa la/ skabs cig ma ga ta'i dge slong sgrub pa po la nye gnas gcig yod pa de/ de'i mtshan rtags dang ldan par mthong nas/ sgrub pa po dge slong la maṇ+ḍal rin po che sna tshogs bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang bcas te yang dang yang du phul bas/ khyod nga la gdam ngag 'dod dam zer ba la/ rig 'dzin gyis smras pa/ nga khyed kyi nye gnas dpa' bo'i rtags can 'di zhu'o byas pas/ des de la phul lo/ /de nas khong gnyis kyi sgrub khang du phyin pa dang / ro sog phon tsam gcig dkyil 'khor gyi steng na 'dug go /de nas rig 'dzin des dge tshul de la khyod ro la dpa' ba'i rtags yod pa yin pas ma 'jigs par 'di'i lce chod cig lce de gser gyi ral grir song ba dang nga la byin cig de gar gtad sar 'gro bar nus pa yin te/ nga 'og min du rig 'dzin sgrub tu 'gro ba yin/

ro 'di gser du 'gyur bas de khyed la brngan pa sbyin no zer ro/ /des de mnyam par bzhag go /dge tshul des ro la bzhon nas gris lce gcod du bcug pa dang / ro 'gul zhing mig hrig hrig kha tab tab byed pa dang / lce dar sham tsam cig nyug nyug byung ba la ma zin no/ /lan gnyis su ma zin pa dang / de nas ro'i lce ma chod na dang por nged rang gnyis gsod/ de nas stong gsum dang srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad gsod du 'ong bas bsgrim la chod cig zer ro/ /de nas dge tshul gyis ro dang kha sprad de bsgrim pa dang / sos lce zin nas bcad pas ral grir gyur nas nam mkhar dbyugs te/ dge tshul gyis nam mkhar 'phur ba dang / rig 'dzin na re/ khyed nang pa sangs rgyas pa la pham pa 'ong ba yin pas ral gri ni nga dbang na mar la shog cig zer ba la/ de ltar yin mod ngas ltad mo lta yi zer nas ri rab kyi khar song nas/ gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gza' skar dang bcas pa dang / lcog bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum bkod pa dang bcas pa la bltas pas legs par mthong / de nas mar 'dzam bu'i gling ngogs su ral gri dbyugs pas rig 'dzin gyi drung du byung ba na/ rig 'dzin gyis smras pa/ ro gser du gyur pa de dge tshul gyis shig 'dis dge slong lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba mdang ste/ rus pa ma chod cig bcad na log 'tshor 'gyur te phyis mi skye'o/ /gzhan du na nang bcad kyang nub mo skye'o/ /de skad zer te kho rang gis ral gri nam mkha' la dbyugs te 'og min du song ngo / /dge tshul des slob dpon dge slong de la smras pa/ 'o cag dge slong lnga brgya'i bzhugs sa gtsug lag khang gcig bzhengs dgos pas/ mgon po la sa gzhi zhu ba'i gtor ma mdzod cig zer nas bha liṃ byas pas bya rog gis 'khyer nas mtsho cig gi dkyil na de'u yod pa'i khar bzhag de'u de'i khar gtsug lag khang gcig brtsigs te ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla dang bcas pa la dpe byas nas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang o tan+ta pu ri bya ba yod pas/

rgyal po chen po'i thugs dam gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dpe yang de las byas nas 'gran gyi do med pa sde snod gsum dang sngags rgyud sde thams cad dang mi 'gal zhing byin rlabs kyang shin tu che ba zhig yong ba mchi bas/ de la dpe bya'o gsungs pas rgyal po shin tu dges te/ des na shin tu bka' drin che bas mkhan po rin po ches sa gzhi byin gyis rlabs par zhu 'tshal/ ces zhu ba phul ba dang / mkhan po'i gsung gis khyed bod kyi lha 'dre mi ma yin rtsub po 'dug pas/ nga byang chub kyis sems kyi 'dul ba yin pas thul mi thul lta yi/ rgyal po rang rmang thing cig gsungs pas/ de nas mkhan pos sa gzhi byin gyis rlabs/ mnga' bdag nyid kyi sku la dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol/ phyag tu gser thogs nas rmang brkos pas/ sa khru gang tsam gyi 'og nas 'bras dkar mo khal gcig dang / sa zhag zho'i kri ma lta bu mdog ser po ro shin tu mngar ba ka ra'i dro ba can mang po byung nas/ rgyal po nyid kyi zhal du yang gsol/ dbu la yang byugs so/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i bsam pa yang 'grub/ bod yul du chos kyi bstan pa dar yong gsungs so/ /de nas rmang bting nas brtsigs pas/ dge bsnyen nyer gcig la sogs pa bod kyi gnod sbyin mthu bo che dang / mthu mo che rnams kyi gtad byas nas nyin mo brtsigs pa nub mo bshig nas brtsig tu ma ster ro/ /der slob dpon la thabs gzhan ci mchis sam zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bdag gis kyang mtshan nyid kyi chos ma lus par shes nas byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa yin te/ bod kyi lha 'dre gdug rtsub can 'di rnams mi thul ba 'dug pa la thabs cig yod kyi gsungs nas/ bod kyi klu srin gdug pa can 'di rnams drag pos 'dul dgos pa 'dug pas/ de la bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug bya ba de na/ u rgyan rgyal po'i sras mdzad pa'i slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba sprul pa'i sku mthu che la rtsal drag pa/

gsang sngags kyi spyod pa mdzad pa cig bzhugs pas de spyan drangs na rgyal po'i dgongs pa 'grub la mi ma yin gdug pa can rnams kyang thul bar 'gyur ro gsungs pas/ de nas bka' lung de mnga' bdag gi mnal lam du byung ba skad mdzad nas/ phyi skor nang 'khor pa kun la bka' stsal pa/ mdangs gsum nga'i rmi lam na/ rgya gar bal yul gyi mtshams yang le shod kyi brag phug bya ba na u rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa zhes bya ba bzhugs pas de spyan drangs na nga yi bsam pa 'grub ces pa cig rmis par ltar/ 'di khyed rnams kyis spyan drangs dgos pas khyed bang chen pa gsum btang ngo / /bka' bgros gyis shig gsungs pa dang / de la 'bangs rnams na re/ 'thad do/ rigs so zer kyang bang chen khas len pa ma byung ba la/ der rgyal po nyid kyis/ sbas rmang po che gsal snang dang / seng mog lha lung gnyis la bka' nan stsal nas/ g.yog po gsum ste dpon g.yog lnga la gser bre gang dang / bar gyi lam rgyags la sogs pa bkur nas lam du bcug pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan lam du srung ma rnams kyis bskul nas/ bod yul has po ri'i rtsa bar bod kyi btsad po lha khang cig brtsig pas/ slob dpon gyi 'byon lam du bang chen pa mi lnga yong ba yod pas de rnams thang chad/ nyon mongs pas slob dpon nyid mang yul gung thang tsam du 'byon par zhu/ zhes srung ma rnams kyis bskul ba de bzhin du slob dpon pad+mas tshur byon pa'i lam du sa bdag ma bzhi btul/ de nas tsan+dan gyi khog nas byon pa'i thugs rje chen po rang byung mched bzhi'i rab gnas mdzad nas bkris par byas/ de nas bal yul gyi 'phags pa shing kun gyi rtsar byon pas/ de'i sa bdag sbrul lto nag po bya bas bar chad byas te/ nyi ma phyed nas nam srod yol slob dpon gyi bsnyen pa'i phur pa gcig la sngags btab te nam mkha' la 'phang pas/ phyogs de'i pha bong bdun dang /

de'i rtse mo la yod pa'i gshin rje nag po dang rdo ba'i sku gcig yod pa thams cad nam mkha' la 'phur te lha 'dre thams cad btul nas da lta rdo ba de sa la nub kyang mos pa byed pa yod gsungs so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis mang yul gung thang du bzhugs pa dang bang chen pa rnams dang mjal nas/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyis mkhyen bzhin du khyod su yin/ gang du 'gro gsungs pas/ nged bod kyi btsad pos slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan 'dren du btang pa yin khyed lags sam zhus pas/ yin yong / ngo ni zla ba gsum gyi gong nas srung ma rnams kyis bskul byung nas 'ong / khyed bang chen pa rnams nyon mongs kyi dogs nas ngas 'dir yong nas zla ba gsum 'dir bsdad pa yin/ khyed re 'gor/ da nga la 'bul rgyu ci yod phul cig gsungs nas/ der bang chen pas phyag byas nas gser phye bre gang po phul bas/ da dung ci yod phul cig gsungs pas/ rgyal pos de ka las ma bkur/ da nged rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bran du 'bul zhes phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas nas slob dpon gyi zhabs spyi bos blangs pas/ der slob dpon mnyes te/ ngas khyed bod kyi dad pa la rgyu zog 'dug gam mi 'dug bltas pa yin/ nga la snang ba thams cad gser du song ba yin gsungs nas/ phyag g.yas pa gung thang g.yas phyogs su brkyangs pas/ g.yas phyogs kyi ri thams cad g.yon du bsgyur/ phyag g.yon pa nub phyogs su brkyangs pas g.yon thams cad g.yas su bsgyur/ sa rdo kun yang gzi dang 'phyong dang gser du bsgyur nas bang chen pa rnams la yang byin nas nga'i mthu dang rdzu 'phral ni 'di lta bu yod/ khyed rang rnams nga la yid ches pa gyis/ gser gyi bdag la don med kyi/ 'on kyang mnga' bdag gi dgongs pa rdzogs par 'grub cing bsod nams 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir re zhig blangs gyis gsungs nas/ mang yul dang bal yul gyi phyogs su gtor nas btang ste/

dus phyi ma la bod kyi gser thams cad mang yul dang bal yul du 'bo bar 'dug gis gsungs so/ /bang chen pa'i sems la nged la byin pa'i gser g.yu tsho ci yin nam snyam nas so so'i phag tu phyin nas bltas tsa na bden par gser du song 'dug der so sor yid ches/ de nas slob dpon dpon slob tshos mar byon te kha la la thog tu byon pas/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / srid pa'i lha chen po 'od lde gung rgyal la sogs pa brgya dang / klu chen mo ma dros gzi can la sogs pa rnams kyis bsus nas/ a tsa ra 'di bod la shor na nged rang bod kyi lha 'dre rnams bran du 'khol ba zhig yong bas/ da lta a tsa ra 'di la bar gcod bya ba rigs zer te mtho 'tshams byas pa la/ 'jig rten gyi lha tshangs pa 'od lnga gung rgyal bya ba des sbrul chen po gcig tu sprul nas mgo bo kha la la'i la thog tu sleb pa byas/ mjug ma khams kyi g.yar mo thang du sleb par byas nas/ nga'i bu tsha dang 'khor g.yog rnams bran du 'dzud dam mi 'dzud zer nas thog bcu gsum phab pas/ slob dpon gyi dbu zhwa'i steng du sol ba ru 'thor song nas klag ma brnyed do/ /de nas yang dag dang phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te gzir bas/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi rang rtags srog gi snying po phul nas bran du khas blangs te dkyil 'khor phyi rim du bzhag go /de nas gtsang po na mar byon te don kha ring mor byon pa dang / zhang zhung gi dgra lha srid pa'i rgyal mo mu tsha med bya bas bar chad bya bar brtsams nas ri chen po gnyis su brdzus te slob dpon dpon g.yog rnams ri bar du bcar bar byas pas/ slob dpon gyis brag la phyag 'khar btsugs nas brag la lam byas te/ brag gi kha na phar byon pas mo rab tu dngangs shing bred par gyur te/ srog gi snying po phul te srung mar khas blangs/ gsang ba'i mtshan yang gangs kyi yum chen kun tu 'od ces bya bar btags so/

/de nas byang gnam thang na mar byon pas/ gnam sman dkar mos slob dpon la thog dbab par brtsams pa na/ phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du chu me long gang tsam bzhag pa dang / der song zer song tsa na khrag skam po sran ma'i rdog po bdun tsam du song 'dug go /de nas mo ya mtshan skyes bred nas mo dpal mo'i dpal mtsho la bros so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dpal mo'i la thog tu sgrub pa zhag bdun bsgrub ste khros pa las/ mtsho nang nas chu pa ru gang blangs nas mtsho me phung du bsgom pas mtsho bun gyis khol byung pa dang / mo sha rus bye bros pa las/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gcig brgyab pas mig g.yas bcar ba dang / mos gus pa btud de zhus pa/ mahā gu ru rdo rje slob dpon lags/ /ston pa'i zhal dkyil rdo rje thod phreng stsal/ /bar chad mi bgyid thugs dam dgongs la slod/ /srog snying phul nas dga' zhing bran du byed/ /zhes gsol zhing dam la btags te ming yang gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig mar btags so/ /de nas 'u yug na mar byon tsa na/ ya ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa rnams kyis ri bar du gcar bar bsam nas cho 'phrul byas pa las/ slob dpon gyis ri thams cad phyag 'khar gyis so sor bor/ g.ya' ri dang gangs ri la sogs pa'i gnas thams cad bshig ya ma bcu gnyis skyong ma bcu gnyis rnams kyis srog snying phul nas dam la btags so/ /de nas the'u sha mo lung du byon tsa na/ yar la sham pos g.yag dkar po ri logs tsam gcig tu sprul nas nyal rlangs dang / kha rlangs dang / sna rlangs las na bun dang sprin du byas/ sna dang kha chu las kha ba dang bu yug tu btang pas/ slob dpon gyis lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas nas sna nas bzung / zhags pa'i phyag rgyas ske nas bcings/ lcags sgrog gi phyag rgyas rkang lag bzhi sgrog tu bcug dril bu'i phyag rgyas g.yag de btsog brdung byas pas/ khye'u dar gyi gos can gcig tu gyur te srog snying phul nas dam la btags so/

/de nas byang zangs zangs du byon nas byang gi 'brog chen mo brgyad btul nas dam la btags/ de nas rta sde shang tshal du phebs tsa na/ grom pa rgyang gi lha khang gi rab gnas kyang mdzad do/ /de nas lha thang lha'i rtsar byon dang / thang lha'i nyams sad par bya ba'i phyir gnod sbyin chen po cig gi lus su sprul te/ slob dpon dpon g.yog rnams bza' ba'i tshul du byas pa dang / slob dpon gyi phyag sdigs mdzub gcig sug byas pas/ byis pa g.yu'i zur phud can cig tu log gi song ba dang / 'o 'di klu'i rgyal po me thod dkar po zhes kyang bya/ gnyan chen po thang lha zhes kyang bya ba yin pas/ 'di la ngas gro cig blangs gi gsungs nas gshegs song bas/ phyi dro gro 'khor tsam na na bza'i phu rung gi nang nas ci yang mi dro ba'i khur ba lab leb 'dra ba dang / zhal zas sna tshogs bsnams nas dam la btags so/ /de nas g.yas ru na mar byon pas g.yas ru'i lha 'dre thams cad ru lag tu bros so/ /g.yas ru gtsang gi 'grams su lha khang gi rab gnas mdzad do/ /de nas byang 'phan yul du byon tsa na/ byang ting ting lo sman dang / stag sman zor gdong ma dang / byang phug mo la sogs pa rnams kyi byang thun gsum gyi lhags pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu byas te/ slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa la rgyab pas/ 'khor rnams kyang reng la khad/ slob dpon nyid kyi sku bag ser tsam byung ba la/ slob dpon gyis gangs ri gnod sbyin gyi rten me phung du bsgom pa las/ mar la lcags tshan phog pa bzhin du lhan gyis zhu bas/ bod kyi gnod sbyin mo rnams kyis srog snying phul nas dam la btags so/ /de nas yang gtsang gi gtsang la gdong po'i gru la brgal te/ stod lung zhong par byon pa dang / slob dpon gyi dro bzhes byed ran 'dug pas blon pos grabs kyis shig gsungs pa la/ blon pos chu mi 'dug pas ci drag zhus pas/ khyod rang snod ze cig gsungs te mthu dang nus pa phul du byung ba'i rtags kyis phyag 'khar brag la rgyab pas chu ci 'dod byung nas bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub ste deng sang gi bar du yang zhong pa'i lha chu zhes kun la grags pa 'di yin no/

/de nas kha la brag ring du dgung zhag bzhugs nas bod kyi btsan thams cad dam la btags so/ /de nas zam phug tu bzhugs te bdud thams cad dam la btags so/ /de nas g.yag ra'i rong du bzhugs te bod kyi rgyal po dang 'gong po thams cad dam la btags so/ /de nas has po ri dang nye bar byon pa'i tshe/ bod kyi btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bsu ba mdzad de/ rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la nga bod kyi mgo nag rje yin pas nga la phyag 'tshal snyam/ slob dpon gyi thugs dgongs la nga grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa slob dpon du spyan drangs pa yin pas nga la phyag byed de 'ong snyam nas phyag la ma 'dum mo/ /der slob dpon gyi nga che nga btsun gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /khams gsum sems can 'chi la skrag /yo ga tshe yi rig 'dzin grub/ /nga 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /rdo rje tshe sgrub kyi gdam ngag bdog /skye 'chi med pa'i sku thob pas/ /lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /nga rgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /khams gsum dbang 'dud kyi gdam ngag bdog /snang srid 'khor 'das kyi dpe cha la/ /drang don nges don gyi bshad pa byed/ /nga dge bshes pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /'khor 'das shan 'byed kyi gdams pa bdog /sems nyid kyi shog bu rnal ma la/ /tshig dang bral ba'i yi ge bris/ /nga yig mkhan pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /chos yi ge med pa'i gdams ngag bdog /'di ltar snang ba'i gyang logs la/ /gnyis su med pa'i lha ris byas/ /nga lha bzo pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /snang stong 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag bdog /mi dug lngas nad kyis nyen pa la/ /zag med sman gyis gso bar byed/ /nga sman pa pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /bdud rtsi chos kyi gdams ngag bdog /dad pa che ba'i mdun gros kyang / /mi tshe gtan gyi mdun ma byas/ /nga gtso bo pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /'khor ba rtsad gcod kyi gdams ngag bdog /shes rab snying rje'i mtshon thogs nas/

/nyon mongs log pa'i dgra bo btul/ /nga dpa' bo pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /'khor ba ru bzlog gi gdams ngag bdog /dug lnga'i gdon lnga dgrar lang na/ /ye shes lnga yi ngo bor grub/ /nga mthu chen pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /dug lnga rtsad gcod kyi gdams ngag bdog /khyod gdong dmar srin po bod kyi rje/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i 'khang sems can/ /nga rgyal 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /bod kyi mnga' bdag ma lags sam/ /khyed mnga' thang che ba blo ba dga'/ /rgyal po nyid la phyag mi 'tshal/ /rgyal po'i na bza' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs nas thal mo ya gcig deng mdzad nas phyag g.yas kyis btsal bas/ rgyal po'i na bza' la me lhab kyi 'bar ma thag rgyal po 'khor bcas shin tu 'gyod de phyag dbu thod bud bud du btsal nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ dus gsum kun mkhyen pad+ma 'byung gnas khyed lta bu la phyag ma btsal ba sogs bdag cag ma rig mun pas sgrib pas sgo gsum gyi sdig pa tshab po che 'di ltar bgyis pa lags/ da ni gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas bshags dgos na/ thabs ji ltar byas na legs bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rdo'i mchod rten lnga rang byon dang khyad par med pa bzo khyad shin tu thon pa nyi ma gcig la grub par byas na phan yon shin tu che'o gsungs pas/ rgyal pos 'o na bzo bo ji ltar grag zhus pas/ zas kyi grabs kyis bzo bo rnams sleb yong ba yod gsungs ma thag /bal po rdo bzo ba lnga krong gis sleb byung bas/ rgyal po shin tu dga' ste zas skom gya nom pas tshim par byas la/ bzhengs lugs ji ltar 'gab slob dpon la zhus pas/ nged rang mchod yon rnams lugs gnyis gang byed kyang thog mar tshe bsring ba 'di rang gal che bas tshe ring mchod rten bzhengs dgos te/ de la bzo khyad ci 'dra zhig dgos na/ mchod rten gyi bum ldir gyi ldan la tshe'i bum pa rang byon gyi tshul du yod pa cig dgos gsungs nas/

tshe chu der sbed pa'i cho ga mdzad pa la rten nas da lta'i bar du yang bum pa'i gzugs kun gyis mthong ba yod do/ /de nas rang re rnams tshe ring ba'i dgos pa dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa cig nyams su len dgos pas chos gter mchod rten bsgrub bo/ /de la bzo khyad ji ltar dgos na/ brag ri po ti gzing pa 'dra ba'i steng du dgos gsungs pa'i brag po ti 'dra ba yang da lta kun gyis mthong bar yod do/ /de'i rjes nged rang rnams dam pa'i chos bya ba la bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog dgos pas na/ bdud 'dul mchod rten bya ste/ de la bzo khyad ji lta bu zhig yod na/ brag ro bsgong pa 'dra ba'i steng du rgyag dgos gsungs pa'i brag de yang kun gyis mthong ba yod do/ /de nas rang re rnams dam pa'i chos la bar chad med par byas nas/ gsang sngags pa 'dod yon lam du byed pa la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dgos pas na/ longs spyod mchod rten bsgrub ste/ de'i bzo khyad ni nor bu'i khong du nor bu bzhag pa'am/ gtor gzhong du gtor ma bzhag pa lta bu dgos gsungs pa'i brag gzhong pa 'dra ba'ang da lta kun gyis mthong bar yod do/ /de nas rang re rnams rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob pa zhig dgos pas na/ dngos grub mchod rten bzhengs par bya ste/ de'i bzo khyad ni brag nor bu mig gsum/ rin po che spungs pa 'dra ba'i steng du dgos pas brag nor bu 'dra ba'ang da lta kun gyis mthong bar yod cing mchod rten rnams kyang bzo khyad phul du byung ba rgya gar lugs kho na'i ngos byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba da lta'i bar du yang kun gyis mchod pa'i gnas su bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /de ltar rgyal pos rdo mchod rnams bzhengs pa'i dus/ ra rdzi zhig shin tu ngo mtshar skyes te/

nga rang yang 'di lta bu'i mchod rten zhig 'grub na snyam ra dkar mo'i 'o mas brdzis pa'i sa phag gi mchod rten phru gu zhig bzhengs te dkar rtsi bran pas/ slob dpon rin po ches khyed kyi 'di lta bu byed pa shin tu ngo mtshar bas 'di la ngo mtshar mchod rten du ming thogs gsungs pa'ang deng sang gi bar du yod do/ /de nas slob dpon rin po ches rab gnas dang bkra shis mnga' gsol la sogs pa legs par mdzad rjes bzo bo lnga po yang mchod rten so so la thim zhing / bzo chas rnams gter du bzhugs pa'i brag zangs mo che kha phub pa 'dra ba da lta yang yod/ 'di lta bu'i rdo mchod bzhengs tshul gyi lo rgyus khyad par can 'di rnams gzhan du gsal ba zhig ma mthong yang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung las lo rgyus 'di rnams sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun yin pa'i tshul mdzad nas gsungs kyang / don la sngags 'chang nyid rang bai ro tsa na'i sku'i sprul pa yin par gdon mi za bas/ sngon gyi skye ba dran pa'i rnam par thar pa yin nges su 'dug ces bdag gi bla ma 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can gyi gsung las yang yang thos so/ /de nas slob dpon pho brang du spyan drangs nas gser gyi khri la bzhugs nas/ zhal skyems dang / shoms dang / 'jig rten gyi spyan gzigs sna tshogs drangs/ za 'og gi smug ber sku la gsol nas bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal pos phyag rten dang bcas pas phyag mdzad nas 'di skad zhus so/ /e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar che thugs rje'i bdag /bdag ni srin po gdong dmar bod kyi rje/ /bod kyi mi ni 'dul dka' bas/ /dam pa chos kyi rten cig gzugs/ /slob dpon sprul pa'i skur bzhugs pas/ /sa gzhi byin gyis rlabs par zhu/ /zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bod kyi mnga' bdag rgyal po legs/ /bod gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'dre yul du 'dug pas/

de la klu'i gter bzhugs dgos par 'dug gsungs nas/ ma dros gzi can la klu gter bcug cing sa slong ba'i cho ga mdzad/ de nas pho brang has po rir byon nas chu gtor gzi'i phor pa gang la ting nge 'dzin gyi rgya bskyed nas slob dpon gyis lha 'dre zil gnon gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /hūm̐ nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas te/ /mngal gyi ma gos mtsho skyes rdo rje yin/ /nga la gnod pas mi tshugs tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes/ /lus ngag yid gsum lha ru gsal bas dregs pa zil gyis gnon/ /lha 'dre'i rtog 'dzin chod pas 'jig pas sdig tu med/ /nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lha srin sde brgyad shong yang shong / /shong yang shong te yang yang yangs/ /sems nyid stong pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lha yang med te 'dre yang med/ /nga la cho 'phrul ci bstan yang / /nga la g.yo ba rdul tsam med/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma chen po 'di/ /mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed/ /so sor thob pa sngags kyis byas/ /phyag rgyas pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med/ /tshig bshad bden pas bkrol te bsngo/ /'di khyer sa gzhi gnang ba sbyin/ /khri srong lde'u btsan bsam pa bsgrub/ /lha khang brtsigs shig lha 'dre kun/ /sngags 'chang nga yi bka' ma bcag /gum gum chum chum las la 'dur/ /zhes gsungs pas lha 'dre dregs pa can thams cad kyi rang rtags srog gi snying po phul nas dam la btags so/ /de'i dus su be re'i thang la yar zhud bya ba de ma 'dus nas/ der slob dpon gyis thang lha'i rtsar byon pa dang / khos slob dpon la thog brgyab pas/ slob dpon gyi dbu zhwa'i steng du sol ba'i dum bu gcig tu song ngo / /der slob dpon gyi yar la thog 'phongs pas gangs kyi rtse mo zhur song bas thang lha yar zhur du grags so/ /de nas chab gtor des bka' 'og tu 'dus so/ /de nas sma chen spom ra kho 'ong du ma 'dod de/ der slob dpon gyis lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas snying nas bzung zhing bkug pas/

kho rkang pa ya gcig khams kyi g.yar mo thang du bzhag ya gcig pho brang has po ri la bzhag nas bdag g.yar khams che ba gcig lags na'ang / ban chung khyod kyi bka' nan ches pas nga mi 'ong ba'i dbang ma byung bas 'dir 'ong ba yin/ da bka' ci stsal zer ba la/ der slob dpon gyis gtor ma 'di khyer la mnga' bdag gi dgongs pa sgrubs shig gsungs pas/ yang kho na re/ bka' stsal ba bzhin byed dgos na bdag skam chas la dga' bas nga la skam chas cig zhu zer nas der snod dkar po cig gi nang du rin po che brdar te byin gyis rlabs nas byin zhing dam la btags so/ /de nas klu ma dros gzi can dang / yar la sham po dang / sma chen spom ra dang / 'gyogs chen ldong ra dang / byang la btsun chen mo dang / lha 'od lde gung rgyal dang / bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas tshar bcad cing rjes su bzung ste khams gsum zil gyis gnon par mdzad/ de nas slob dpon rin po ches gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs sar byon te/ brtsig gseb tu bzlas yungs gtor nas me sbar ro/ /de'i tshe rgyal po spe dkar klu tsha za ma ti zhes ba'i bsam pa la/ sa gzhi thams cad zhang pos dbang pa la mi'i phrogs pa 'di ma legs snyam nas/ 'khor the rang stong sde bshig tu btang pas der phyin pa na me 'bar nas bshig ma thub par log byung ste/ rje ci legs bshig pa'i klag mi gda'/ 'du 'phro me ltar 'bar/ tsha tsha skar ltar 'khrug cing gda'/ zer ro/ /der 'gong po spun dgus bshig tu phyin pas kyang me 'bar te/ spe dkar la sngar ltar zer ro/ /der spe dkar rang gis phyin pas kyang me 'bar te bshig ma thub nas/ 'di ci'i lan snyam du bsam pa dang / de ring gi mon bu a tsa ra de yin thag chod pas sngags ci bzlos kyi yod snyam nyan du phyin pas/ slob dpon gyis mkhyen te nyan pa'i rna ba la phur pa gcig btab pas rna ba 'on/

yang rdzas dang rten 'brel sogs ji ltar byed blta bar phyin te bltas pa'i tshe/ de yang mkhyen nas mig la phur pa gcig btab pas mig long / de nas 'gyogs par bros 'gro dgos snyam pas/ de yang mkhyen te rkang pa la phur pa gcig btab pas rkang pa zha nas der 'gong po spun dgu'i khyogs la bteg nas ngu rdzi di ri ri song ngo / /de nas khos zhang po klu la sa gzhi thams cad ni mon bu a tsas 'phrogs/ nga'ang 'di ltar btang na da khyed bsdod dam byas pas/ klu rnams la dbang ma dros pa che bas/ nged kyi kha sing du sa gzhi dag srog snying phul ba yin pas/ da khyod rang yang skyabs su song zer te/ der rgyal po spe dkar gyis kyang srog snying phul nas g.yog tu khas blangs so/ /'di skabs kyi spe dkar ni rgyal 'gong spe dkar yin gyi/ rgyal po chen po bhe ha rar grags pa'i chos skyong chen po 'di nyid ma yin pa'i tshul ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /gzhan yang dus der slob dpon chen pos dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig g.ya' ri mo/ gangs ri mo nyi shu rtsa gcig bod kyi gnod sbyin mthu bo che dang / mthu mo che thams cad dam la btags/ gza' chen po brgyad dang rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dbang du bsdus te/ ri rdo ri ru phab/ klung rdo klung du bsdus nas lha khang gi rmang bting te/ rgyal po nyid kyi dbu rtse rigs gsum ri rab kyi tshul du byas/ 'khor sa gser gyi ri bdun gyi tshul du byas/ yag sha gong 'og nyi ma dang zla ba'i tshul du byas/ gling chen bzhi/ gling chung brgyad rnams dang / gzhan yang dbu tshal gser khang gling jo mo tshe spom za dmar rgyan gyis bzhengs/ khams gsum zangs mkhar gling jo mo pho skyong za rgyal mo btsun gyis bzhengs/ jo mo 'grom za byang chub 'od kyis dge rgyas bye ma gling bzhengs/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad ni/ ar+ya pa lo'i gling / byams pa'i gling / 'jam dpal gling /

sems bskyed gling / khrims kha gling / sngags pa gling / bsam gtan gling / ye rtsa gling / tshad ma gling / sgra bsgyur gling / sna tshogs lcags khra gling / spe dkar gling / zur bzhir mchod rten bzhi/ phyi lcags ris bskor ba/ phyogs bzhi na mgon khang bzhi/ sgo'i gdong na rdo ring bzhi/ rdo ring chen po bzhi'i steng na zangs kyi khyi chen mo bzhi/ de ltar rmang bting nas slob dpon dgongs pa la zhugs nas lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis brtsig rogs byas pas/ ri rdo rje ri la bzhag pa klung du bsnyil nas nyin mo mis brtsigs pa las/ mtshan mo 'dres brtsigs pa mtho bar gyur to/ /de nas slob dpon gyi thugs dgongs la ngas lha ma srin sde brgyad thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum dam la thogs bsam ma thogs snyam nas dgongs pa la zhugs te gzigs pas/ lha ma srin sde brgyad po gzhan thams cad dam la thogs 'dug pas/ klu 'di'i lus dam la thogs pas bsam yas brtsig gin 'dug ngag dam la thogs pas bka' nyan zer gyin 'dug yid dam la ma thogs par gnod pa sna tshogs bskyel bar 'dug nas/ yid 'dul ba'i phyir du slob dpon klu 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas yod pa dang / brtsig bzo mkhan po ha shang mahā ya na dang / hor pak+ṣe karma la sogs pas brtsig bzo zin nas/ shing bzo mkhan po rgya nag lang tsho he dang / bal po bha ru la sogs pas ste'u klad la skor zhing / rgyal po shing ga na yod/ shing lag rdugs so byas pas/ der rgyal po dngangs te/ shing 'di tsam zhig gang nas btsal snyam te rgyal po 'dar yed yed byung ba dang / bu tshal gyi klu'i rig pas klag brnyed nas/ des rgyal po la bar chad byas te/ mi dkar rta dkar cig gi cha lugs su byas nas rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs nas/ rje rgyal po chen po bsam yas kyi shing dgos tshad ngas byin gyis/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dgongs pa bkrol bar zhu byas pas/

rje'i thugs la dngos grub yin snyam zhal gyis bzhes pas/ der 'o na nga rgyal pos slob dpon dgongs pa bkrol du mi 'jug ri mna' skyol zer/ der rgyal pos mna' bskyal te/ de nas 'phying phu'i brag phug ge gong du slob dpon gyi spyan sngar byon pas/ slob dpon gyi sku ni mi snang la/ khyung chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'dug pas/ slob dpon chen po lags/ dgongs pa bkrol bar zhu zhus pas ma gnang pa la/ yang slob dpon chen po dgongs pa bkrol bar zhu/ dngos grub chen po bdog zhus pas/ der dgongs pa bkrol ba dang / rgyal pos gong gi bka' mchid gsol bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rje mnga' bdag chen po lags/ gtsug lag khang gi shing rang bzhin gyi yong ba yin te/ bdag gi klu 'di lus ngag gnyis ka dam la thogs yod kyang / klu 'di'i yid dam la ma thogs 'dug pas dam la btags snyam pa lags te/ da snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus la babs pa'i dus su sa gzhi klus dbang byed/ nad du mdze rigs bco brgyad dar ba cig 'ong / mthar thug mi'i khang pa thams cad klu'i 'dzin pa zhig 'ong bas thams cad 'jigs pa ste/ sa thams cad sa 'og gi klus khengs te dbang byed pa cig 'ong ngo gsungs so/ /de nas mnga' bdag gis mar byon pa na/ klus gtsang po la shing rnams bkur ste bsam yas la nag mer gyi chags so/ /de nas de'i lo rgyal po dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhes pa la rmang bting nas brtsigs pas/ rta lo la ljongs dbu rtse rigs gsum gling phran bcu gnyis/ khyad par gling bzhi ste bcu drug la sogs pa rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la ji ltar bsam pa bzhin grub pas/ gtsug lag khang gi mtshan la yang dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya bar btags so/ /gtsug lag khang de rnams su ngo mtshar ba'i rten ji ltar bzhugs pa dang / srung ma so so la tha dad gtad pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar dpal bsam yas bzhengs pa'i dus der/

rgyal po nyid kyi thugs dgongs la lha khang 'di rnams su sku rten ji ltar bzhengs dgongs pa na/ de'i nub rgyal po'i mnal lam du mi dkar po gcig byung nas/ khyod sangs rgyas sku gzugs ci la byed zer ba la/ btsad po'i zhal nas slob dpon la zhus nas byed gsungs pas/ mi dkar po de na re/ sa gzhi 'di jo mo sgrol mas byin gyis rlabs pa yin pas/ sngon has po ri'i rtse mo na bcom ldan 'das gtso 'khor rnams gar mdzad kyin bzhugs yod/ de spyan drongs la thugs dam gyis/ 'dzam bu gling na byin rlabs che ba cig 'ong gsungs/ rgyal po'i zhal nas de ga na yod ston gsungs pas/ ba dmar mo 'us sgra 'debs pa'i sa na yod zer ba la/ blon po khams pa phyag phyir khrid has po ri'i rtse mo la gshegs pas/ ri rtse na bcom ldan 'das gtso 'khor bcu gsum tsam gar mdzad kyin bzhugs pa gzigs/ rgyal po dges te he he zhes gsungs pas mnal sad ste/ nang par slob dpon gyi drung du mnal lam gyi tshul rnams zhus pas/ de shin tu bzang / mnal lam rmis pa'i sa der rang re gshegs gsungs pas/ ldong sher gyi ga phyir khrid ste chos rgyal yon mchod lngas has po ri'i rtse mo la byon pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rgyal po la mdang mnal lam la shar ba'i dus ga na 'dug ces gsungs pas/ btsad po'i zhal nas mdang 'di na 'dug zhus/ zhabs bye ma la sug byas pas rdo bya mchu tsam zhig gog pa'i 'og nas rdo'i byang chub chen po the'u dang gzong gi rjes med pa'i spyan khra hrig ge ba gtsug tor nag ldem pa'i byang chub chen po cig phebs byung bas/ rgyal po rab tu dges te 'brang zhags dang / shing rta'i grabs byas shing / shing rta'i steng du phebs pas/ de ma thag sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ de nas shar sgo'i them pa'i khar phebs pa dang / yang sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ de nas dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi 'og khang shing thams cad se ba dang tsan+dan las byas pa'i gtsang khang gi khri la bzhugs pa dang /

yang sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nas rgyal po'i gser gyi nan te la sogs pa'i sku chos rnams shākya thub pa'i sku la phul/ de nas rgyal po'i phyogs mkhan pos nas sku bstan pas/ phyogs mkhan na re/ khyed kyi khang pa dang sbyar na lha 'di chung zer/ de la 'jag ma bkra shis/ de la ras g.yogs/ de la gser gyi 'jim pa lan bdun g.yogs nas bzhengs pa'i gtso bo byang chub chen po bzo bod lugs su byas pa'i lho ngos kyi g.yas gral la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po/ byams pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dang drug byang ngos kyi g.yon gral la/ byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ phyag na rdo rje/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dge bsnyen dri ma med par grags pa/ khro bo mi g.yo ba rnams bzhugs shing / ri mo phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / sgo rnam par dag pa'i sgo gsum/ lte ba'i nang la sku gsum 'byung ba'i rgyud ris/ skor khang phyi ma la mdo sde pad+ma dkar po dang / nang lta la 'dus pa rin po che tog gi mdo'i brgyud ris bkod nas srung ma lcam mo 'gro ba bzang mo la gtad/ dbu rtse bar khang gi shing thams cad bla ba dang seng ldeng las byas shing / rten gtso'i rgyu ba man gyi ko ba la byas shing / bzo rgya nag gi lugs su byas pa'i gtso bo dus gsum sangs rgyas/ g.yas phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' nam snying / byams pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ sa snying / dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo kaṃ g.yon phyogs na kun bzang / 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/ grib sel/ dge bsnyen dri med/ khro bo kiṃ kaṃ kiṃ zhes pa rgya nag gi skad yin gyis/ don 'og kha dang mthun par bshad/ nang tshur gzigs kyi ri mo la/ yum rgyas pa gleng gzhi'i mdo/ skor khang phyi ma la mdo mngon par byang chub pa'i mdo/ nang lta la sprin chen po'i mdo bkod/ gdong la rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/

sgo'i phyi ngos la gshin rje gshed kyi ri mo/ bar khang sgo gcig thig le nyag cig gi sgo/ srung ma rgyal po shing bya can la gtad/ dbu rtse steng gi shing thams cad thang ma dang som la byas/ rten gtso'i sku ras dang 'jag ma la byas/ bzo lugs rgya gar gyi lugs su byas pa'i gtso bor rnam par snang mdzad mi bzhi rgyab sprod kun rig dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'dra ba la nye ba'i sras brgyad/ sgo bzhi la khro bo phyag na rdo rje bzhi/ mi g.yo ba bzhi brag ri'i gdan la bzhengs pa/ sems dpa' rnams la pad zla'i gdan/ rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ nang gi rgyud ris mdo sde sa bcu pa/ sgo bzhi tshad med bzhi dang bstun/ srung ma chos skyong zangs kyi ber klog can la gtad/ thog rgya phigs khyung mgo lugs su phug steng gi lcog bzhi na/ mdangs dga' ba can gyi sangs rgyas la/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba sbyin gyi brgyud ris/ srung ma chos skyong lag na rdo rje mched bzhi la gtad/ 'gan ji ra gser gar bu lugs las byas pa shel gyi tog can du btsugs nas srung ma chos skyong klu'i rgyal po a nan+da la gtad/ 'khor sa nang ma lho phyogs rol mo'i mchod rdzas kyi bang mdzod gsum na rol chas bkang nas/ gshin rje lag na be con thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ nub phyogs mdo rgyud dam pa chos kyi mdzod gsum na mdo rgya dkar nag gi dpe'i glegs bam gyis bkang nas/ a tsar+ya lag na spu gri thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ byang phyogs rin po che gser gyi bang mdzod gsum na gser dngul zangs lcags kyis bkang nas gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ logs kyi brgyud ris mdo rgya chen rol pas bkang nas/ des ma kheng pa mdo skal bzang gis bkang / 'khor sa phyi ma'i nang gi brgyud ris la sangs rgyas phal po che/ 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa/ 'phags pa snang brgyad kyis bkang nas bris/

mda' yab kyi ngos la rnam snang la sogs rigs lnga'i lha tshogs zhal phyi gzigs dang nang gzigs gnyis su byas/ rnam snang ngan song sbyong ba dang bstun/ chos skyong klu'i rgyal po a nan+da u ta la gtad/ rdo ring pad+ma can la dkar rtsis mdor bsdus bkod nas seng ge bzhag chos skyong sing ha mu kha la gtad/ nang gi 'og tu ka ba'i rmang bcug de'i steng du ka ba/ de'i steng du ka logs/ de'i steng gdung / de'i steng du lcam/ de'i steng du so phag logs la sraṃ cha'i sgo phyi rub pa nang yangs pa byas/ rlung gi mi phyed pa'i 'khor bstan/ 'byed pa'i dbyug gu skam kha/ bya khwa mi 'jug pa'i dra ba/ steng la 'dzeg pa'i gru skas drug bya ba thams cad 'dul ba dang bstun/ brgyud ris thams cad mdo sde dang bstun/ lder bzo thams cad gsang sngags dang bstun/ de ltar lder bzo bdun cu don brgyad/ mdo'i brgyud ris bcu gnyis/ ka ba stong dang rtsa gnyis/ sgo mo sum cu so drug sgo chung bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ seng ge brgya dang rtsa brgyad sogs yod do/ /yag sha gong ma na sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gtso bo shākya thub pa gtso 'khor lnga/ brgyud ris mdo sde skal ba bzang po/ srung ma gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po la gtad/ yag sha 'og ma na gtso bo sangs rgyas tshe dpag med gtso 'khor lnga/ brgyud ris gong dang mthun/ srung ma gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la gtad/ de gnyis nyi zla'i tshul du byas/ mngon pa dang bstun pa'i mdo'i gling phran bcu gnyis la/ shar gyi gling gsum ni/ rnam dag khrims khang gling ni lha tshogs byang chub chen po'i sku gtso 'khor lnga dang / ri mo ni mdo sde ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i bkod pa bzhugs/ chos skyong ni tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can la gtad do/ /so so thar pa'i tshul khrims len pa'i gnas so/ /mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gling na lha tshogs 'jam dpal gyi sku gtso 'khor lnga dang / sgo srung gshin rje gshed gnyis ste bdun bzhugs so/

/ri mo ni snang ba mtha' yas dang / tshe dpag med dang / phal po che'i rgyud ris bzhugs so/ /chos skyong ni gshin rje gshed me'i 'khor lo can la gtad do/ /chos kyi 'chad nyan byed pa'i gling / tshangs ma brda sbyor gling na/ lha gtso bo shākya mu ne gtso 'khor lnga dang / chos skyong rgyal po 'brug gi klog pa can la gtad do/ /'tsho ba zas kyi gling ngo / /lho'i gling gsum la/ bdud 'dul sngags pa'i gling na/ lha tshogs lugs sku byang chub chen po gtso 'khor lnga dang / ri mo ni mdo nam mkha'i snying po'i brgyud ris bzhugs so/ /chos skyong ma mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la gtad do/ /sgrub pa'i bar chad sel ba'i gling ngo / /thugs rje rgyun 'byung ar+ya spa lo'i gling na/ lha tshogs khar+sa pa ṇi gtso 'khor lnga dang / steng phyogs na snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor lnga dang / glo 'bur na rigs gsum mgon po/ phra men mchod rten rgyal po'i sku tshad/ dngul gyi thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun seng ge sgra/ bse'i jo mo stong phrag brgya pa dang / ri mo za ma tog bkod pa lnga bcu'i brgyud ris rnams bzhugs/ chos skyong dbang chen gyi pho nya rnams la gtad do/ /mngon par byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gling ngo / /sgra bsgyur rgya gar gyi gling na/ lha tshogs lugs sku byang chub chen po gtso 'khor lnga dang / ri mo rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rgyud ris bzhugs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin ra gdong can la gtad do/ /rgya las bod du sgra bsgyur ba'i gling ngo / /nub kyi gling gsum la/ lung ston bai ro tsa na'i gling na/ lha tshogs zangs kyi rnam par snang mdzad sku 'khor dang bcas pa/ ri mo ni rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i brgyud ris bzhugs so/ /chos skyong ni glang gi mgo can la gtad do/ /gang zag lung bstan pa'i gling ngo / /dga' ldan byams pa'i gling na/ lha byams pa'i sku gtso 'khor lnga dang /

sgo srung gnyis ste bdun/ steng gi lcog na a mi dhe wa sku gtso 'khor lnga ste bcu gnyis dang / ri mo byams pa'i skyes rabs dang / sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas brtan chen po bcu drug bsam yas kyi dpe/ zhang rgya tsha lhas snang gi skyes rabs rnams bris so/ /chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma dgung ling mgo can la gtad do/ /sgrub brgyud kyi gdam ngag 'bebs pa'i gling ngo / /mi g.yo ba bsam gtan gling na/ lha tshogs rnam par snang mdzad/ gnyan po byin can gyi gtso byas pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga/ skal bzang gi byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug ste nyi shu rtsa drug dang / ri mo tshe dpag med dang / ngan song sbyong ba dang / gtsug tor gyi rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gsum/ 'khor 'khyams na phal po che'i brgyud ris bzhugs/ chos skyong rgyal po dngul mgo can la gtad do/ /bsam gtan sgrub pa byed pa'i gling ngo / /byang gi gling gsum la/ sna tshogs rin chen gling na lha shākya seng ge sku gtso 'khor lnga dang / ri mo ni 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa'i brgyud ris bzhugs so/ /chos skyong rgyal po bya'i sbar mo can la gtad do/ /'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i gling ngo / /sems bskyed byang chub gling na/ lha tshogs ni sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma'i spyan la 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rigs brgya bzhugs so/ /chos skyong ni gnod sbyin no/ /byang chub sems bskyed 'bebs pa'i gling ngo / /spe har dkor mdzod gling na/ lha steng gi sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal gtso 'khor lnga dang / ri mo 'jig rten gyi khams mdang dga' ba'i bkod pa'o/ /chos skyong ni rgyal po spe dkar la gtad do/ /nyi ma'i lha khang na lha'i bu nyi ma'i gzhal yas khang gi bkod pa dang / zla ba'i lha khang na lha'i bu zla ba'i gzhal yas khang gi bkod pa yod do/ /mchod rten bzhi la/ shar lho'i mchod rten dkar po'i nang na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel ma ga ta'i bre drug bzhugs te/

sangs rgyas stong gis brgyan pa bzhengs so/ /las dpon shud bu dpal gyi seng ges byas/ srung ma gnod sbyin skar mda'i gdong can la gtad do/ /lho nub kyi mchod rten dmar po'i nang na/ sngon bskal pa dang po jo bo sgol des khyung tshang nas ston pa'i khrab nya sha lto rgyab/ mdung kha dog 'tshog ldem/ ral gri ngur ma'i rdo gcod la sogs pa go mtshon bcug ste pad+ma stong gis brgyan pa bzhengs so/ /las dpon zhang rgya tsha lhas snang gis byas/ srung ma gza' mig dmar la gtad/ nub byang mchod rten nag po'i nang na/ sngon bskal pa dang po'i spre'u dang brag srin mas 'gro ba mi 'phel ba'i dus su ar+ya'i drung nas khong tsho'i zas skal la byin pa'i yar lung zo thang du 'bru sna thams cad btab pa'i phud 'bru sna dang / bskal pa bzang po'i zan tshad bcug ste/ mchod rten stong gis brgyan pa cig bzhengs so/ /las dpon ma ta ra klu gong gis byas/ srung ma gza' lcags mchu can la gtad/ byang shar mchod rten sngon po'i nang na sman mchog a ru ra rnam rgyal dang / bdud rtsi 'chi gsos kyi sman dang / sman mchog thams cad bcug pas lha khang bcu drug gis brgyan pa cig bzhengs so/ /mchod rten 'di shin tu ngo mtshar bas lha'i yul du 'phur nas gshegs pa la/ phyogs bzhir gzer bzhis mnan pa bzhugs so/ /las dpon mchims rdo rje spre chung gis byas/ srung ma gza' nyi ma'i gdong can la gtad do/ /gzhan yang tshe spongs bza' me tog sgron gyis bzhengs pa'i khams gsum zangs mkhar gling ni/ dbu rtse chen mo'i bkod pa yin pa la/ lha grangs rkang grangs sgo'i lta phyogs dbu rtse las cung zad mi 'dra ba yod do/ /srung ma ma cig dpal ldan lha mo la gtad/ pho yongs bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis bzhengs pa'i dbu tshal gser khang gling ni btsun mos bzo bo rnams la zas sna brnyed bskur rim pa mi 'dra ba bcu gsum zhus/ bzo bo rnams kyis btsun mo dgyes pa'i bzo sna'i khyad par bcu gsum ston pa ni/

phyi brtsig pa med pa bzo'i khyad/ nang ka ba med pa bzo'i khyad/ ka zhu bre tsam cig gis bdung chen bcu drug 'degs pa bzo'i khyad/ g.yu'i gdung ma la gser gyi seng ge lug thom ltar 'khrab pa bzo'i khyad/ g.yu'i gdung ma la gser gyi rta pho rgyug la khad pa bzo'i khyad/ spyi gdugs gru bzhi'i nang nas phyogs bzhi nas mchod pa'i lha mo bdun bdun gyis mchod pa 'bul ba bzo'i khyad/ gdugs sgor mo'i nang nas lha'i bu bu mo bdud rtsi 'bul ba bzo'i khyad/ rgya phibs kha phyi lta nang lta bzo'i khyad/ gla gor zho sha'i sgo la gser gyi byi'u skad 'don pa bzo'i khyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis rgya phibs nam mkha' la 'degs pa bzo'i khyad/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis khyams na 'bur du dod pa bzo'i khyad/ rnam par snang mdzad zhal phyogs bzhir gzigs pa bzo'i khyad/ thog gi chu thams cad zangs wa gcig la 'dus nas rdo'i rus sbal steng du yon chab rgyun du 'bul ba bzo'i khyad ste/ de ltar bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa'i 'og khang na gtso bo dus gsum sangs rgyas la 'khor phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo phyag na rdo rje dang / mi g.yo ba gnyis/ kṛ ya'i lha tshogs bco lnga bzhugs/ srung ma rdo rje g.yu sgron ma la gtad/ steng khang rdo rje dbyings su mdzad/ srung ma rgyal po rta sngon mi sngon la gtad/ btsun mo 'brom za byang chub sgron gyis bzhengs pa'i dge rgyas li ma gling ni/ sra ba brtan pa gang gis kyang mi bshig pa cig bzhengs dgos dgongs nas/ so phag nag po ba dmar mo dang / ra dkar mo'i 'o ma dang brdzis nas khro chus bsdams/ rten rnams li ma gtso 'khor dgu spyan drangs/ li sku gnyis klus spyan drangs/ da lta li ma gtso 'khor bdun bzhugs pa'i gtso bo chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ g.yas phyogs na spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dpa'i dbyangs/ phyag na rdo rje/ g.yon gral la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po/

byang sems sman pa'i rgyal po/ khro bo mi g.yo ba rnams bzhugs/ nang gi brgyud ris la sangs rgyas phal po che/ 'khor sa phyi ma la u rgyan skyes rabs rnam thar bris/ chos skyong srung ma gza' pa sangs la gtad do/ /dbu rtse'i lcags ri mu khyud pho rog rdo rje 'gros su byas/ sgo bzhi/ mgon khang brgyad/ mda' yab brgya rtsa brgyad/ thang la dkar zhal phyi'i rgya mtsho 'dra ba byas/ logs kyi gnyer ma yang chu gnyer du byas/ de'i nang du mkhan po'i gzim khang ke ru gling / mthu rtsal gling / klu gling lha khang / dag byed khrus khang gling la sogs pa bzhengs shing / khyams chen mo'i logs ris la gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya dang / mdo phal po che las gzhon nu nor bzang gi bla ma brgya rtsa bsten pa'i ri mo dang / gling bar gyi mun pa'i bkod pa dang / bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa bzhengs tshar ba'i rab gnas kyi bkod pa dang / gzhan yang rgya nag po'i thags rtsed kyi ri mo mang po yod/ chos skyong mgon po beng dmar dang / dpal lha mo dkar mo la gtad do/ gtsug lag khang spyi dang / dkor mdzod gling dang / skor srung ni rgyal po spe dkar la gtad do/ /de nas bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs pa mthar phyin nas/ lug gi lo la slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi nyi ma 'od zer gyi skur bstan nas rab gnas mdzad pas byin rlabs ngo mtshar can gyi rtags drug byung ste/ byang chub gling gi dpal rnam par snang mdzad nam mkha' la 'phags pa dang / dbu rtse'i lha thams cad phyir shar gyis byon byung pa la/ rgyal po'i thugs la da nang du ji ltar tshud snyam pa'i tshe/ skad cig la nang du tshud pa dang / dbus kyi rdo ring gi steng na zangs kyi khyi mo che ba bzhi yod pas/ phyogs bzhir mchong skad bzhi 'don pa dang / 'khor sa'i smyug ma ma btab par dus cig la shad kyis skyes pa dang drug byung ngo / /de ltar dpal gyi bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po legs par bzhengs shing bkra shis mnga' gsol la sogs pa mdzad pa'i rjes su/

mdo dang gsang sngags gsar rnying sogs kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar ches cher gsal bar gyur cing / bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che shin tu dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel thams cad legs par 'grig ste/ mdor na chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dgongs pa'i bzhed don thams cad ji lta ba bzhin 'grub pa de'i tshe/ mkhan slob rgyal po dang bcas pa'i zhal nas/ nged rang mchod yon gyis bzhengs pa'i bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ngan song gi gnas spong / phyag dang bskor ba byas na u rgyan rdo rje chen po'i pho brang pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag par skye bar 'gyur bas 'dzam bu'i gling na 'gran zla dang bral ba yin no/ /zhes mgrin gcig tu gsungs shing zhal gyi bzhes par sngon gyi yig tshangs tshad ldan rnams las bshad pas/ rang nyid dge legs su 'dod pa'i skal bzang las 'phro can rnams kyis dgongs par mdzod la/ gtsug lag khang khyad par can de rnams la phyag dang bskor ba dang mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed 'bul ba la gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor ba la nan tan snying por bgyid pa gal che ba legs so/ /de dag gi ni dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bka' srung dang bcas pa'i byon tshul legs par bshad pa chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu dges par byed pa yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba las spyir gtsug lag khang dang srung ma rnams kyi byon tshul bshad pa'i skabs ste dang po'o// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa bye brag bka' srung mchog gi byon tshul bshad pa la gnyis ste/ gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud dang / de'i man ngag zab mo byung tshul gyi yi ge rnying ma sogs las 'byung tshul bzhin bshad pa dang /

rgyal po shel phreng dkar po'i rtsa gdang bshad pa'i man ngag gi rgyud rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ thog mar yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas chos skyong chen po 'di nyid kyi spu gri dmar po snying gi rgyud gsungs shing bstan pa'i srung mar bka' bsgos shing zhal gyis bzhes pa'i tshul/ bar du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgya gar me 'bar gyi dur khrod du slar yang dam tshig phog cing rgyud kyang gter nas bzhes te bka' srung du mnga' gsol ba'i tshul/ tha mar rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung mar bha ta hor gyi bsgom grwa nas spyan drangs shing slob dpon chen po'i bka' bzhin gtsug lag khang gi skor srung mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na 'og min cho 'phrul bstan pa'i zhing khams zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog na zhe sdang gdug pa'i me dpung dmar nag tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil/ rak+ta chen po rab tu chags pa'i rba klong mi zad pa 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang / dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i chos 'byung gzhal yas khang gi dbus na bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po nyid 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ khro bo'i dbang po dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po nyid kyi skur bzhengs nas khams gsum ma lus pa dbang du bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par gyur to/ /de'i tshe nyon mongs pa dug lnga chos nyid bde ba chen po'i ngang la rol ba'i dregs pa can gyi 'khor 'dus pa ni/ nag po srang med dang / dma' chen thang so la sogs pa bdud kyi tshogs dang / dmu rje legs pa/ dmu lcam rgyal mo la sogs pa dmu'i tshogs rnams dang /

skyes bu klu btsan dang / ya ma skya gcig dang / yan pa skya bdun la sogs pa btsan gyi tshogs dang / rgyal po nyi sngas dang / srog bdag rgyal po dang / rgyal po sil ma drug cu la sogs pa rgyal po'i tshogs dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rtse'u dmar po la sogs pa gnod sbyin til gyi gang bu'i grangs bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gzhan yang gying bzhi la sogs pa gdug pa can gyi 'khor grangs dang tshad med pa dag gis bskor te bzhugs pa las/ 'khor mthu rtsal can de rnams lhan cig tu 'dus pa'i gdug rtsub kyi kha rlangs las nad rnam pa sna tshogs dang / mtshon cha'i 'phrul 'khor gyi 'jig pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad brlag par nye ba na/ dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po'i 'khor gyi khrod nas mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje dhe ma'am/ ming gzhan rdo rje pad+mas rang gi stan las lang ste/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol te/ e ma ho bcom ldan dbang chen rgyal/ /gdug sems dregs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /srid pa gsum po brlag byed na/ /thugs rje'i bdag po'i bka' non mdzod/ /ces bskul ba na/ bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /rang rig ye shes ma shar bas/ /ma rig nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i rgyu/ /sa bon rtsub mo'i sems kyis 'phang / /'jig rten dregs pa'i gdug sems can/ /drag po sngags kyis bdag dbang bsdu/ /zhes bka' stsal nas/ hriḥpad+ma tsan+da mahā kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ /zhes gtum po'i rtsa sngags 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin nyid kyis/ dpal gyi mgul nas 'phrul gyi ljags brkyangs te/ sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra ltar sgrog par mdzad pa na/ 'khor gyi dregs byed thams cad 'dar zhing dngangs te brgyal bar gyur to/ /de las lang pa na/ gong du 'dus pa'i 'khor bdud dang /

dmu dang / btsan dang / rgyal po dang / gying dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa can de dag gi srog gi snying po bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la phul nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung bar bka' bsgos pa bzhin 'jig rten dregs byed kyi 'khor rnams kyis kyang khas blangs shing dam bcas par gyur to/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rtse'u dmar po zhes grags pa'i dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid kyi rgyud spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud ces bya ba'i le'u bdun pa'i bdag nyid can/ 'di yang bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin nyid gyis gsungs pa yin te/ de yang le'u drug pa lta spyod gnad kyi le'us rjes su rgyud gtad pa'i le'u gsungs pa ni/ ji skad du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /nga yi 'khor du 'dus pa rnams/ /snang stong sgyu ma lhun grub la/ /ma rig dregs pas rtog pa'i sgrib/ /chags sdang rang gar shor ba yin/ /gdug pa'i gnod sbyin skya bdun 'di/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir sgrub 'dod na/ /lta ba gdeng thob ldan pa yi/ /snying rjes rab tu spangs la bsgrub/ /len spongs byas na bsgrub nas de bor na rang srog chad/ /mchod pa yel na sgrub dus su ga stong bshos su gtong god kha gtong / /'ben med mda' ling ga la bcas pa sngags bzlas na 'phang 'khor la gnod/ /gsang rgyud bstan pa'i srung mar long / /gnod pa 'byin pas 'gyed pa nges tshig yin/ /rang la legs par ster ba'i lha/ /gdong drag myur 'gyogs ldan pa'i btsan/ /tshe srog len pas shan pa yin/ /kun tshang 'brel bas rgyud ces bya/ /gar babs gcod pa spu gri ste/ /'khor tshogs 'dus pa khyed la gtad/ /ces gsungs pa las/ 'khor rnams kyis bskor ba mang du byas bstod pa/

hūm̐ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung mchog pad+ma'i gsung gi rigs gsung / /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul gang gi sprul na hriḥlas rngam chen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod nas/ kun dgongs pa chos nyid la rnal ma la gnas so/ /rgyud kyi dngos po 'di mkha' 'gro ma'i yi ger btab nas/ bstan pa'i srung mar smod pa bor nas drag po skya bdun gnas su gtad do/ /gnod sbyin snying gi spu gri'i rgyud las rgyud gtad pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud nyan pa'i 'khor rnams kyi khrod nas mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo rnal 'byor ma rdo rje pad+mas bka' bsdu mdzad de 'phrul gyi yi ger btab nas rgyud kyi glegs bam de nyid rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dur khrod me 'bar gyi gnya' ri dmar nag zur gsum gyi mdun/ brag dmar srin po lang 'dra'i brag la gter du sba bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar gong du bkod pa'i bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas rta mgrin gyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas chos skyong chen po 'di nyid la dbang bskur zhing dam tshig gis phog ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung mar bka' bsgos pa'i tshul de dag tshad ldan gyi gsung rab gang las bshad pa yin zhe na/ de yang 'di'i rgyud spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud kyi gling gzhi'i skabs nas gsal bar gsungs pa yin ste/ de yang gleng gzhi'i le'u las/ rgya gar skad du/ lag ga ra tsa so ri spu gri dmar po'i gri ba tsi ta tan tra/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po snying gi rgyud/ dpal ston pa dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad zhu gsol bdag gis thos pa'i dus cig na/ /'og min cho gdul bya 'phrul bstan pa'i zhing khams na/ /zhe sdang dmar nag gdug pa me dpung 'bar ba'i klong /

/rak+ta chags pa rba klong 'khrug pa'i dkyil/ /dmar nag gru gsum dag gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po nyid/ /khams gsum dbang 'dud ting nge 'dzin la snyom par bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na dug lnga chos nyid ngang la rol pa'i 'khor dregs pa can gyi 'khor lo ni/ bdud dang rje legs pa/ dmu dang / btsan yan pa skya bdun dang / rgyal po dang rnam lngas pa/ gying dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa can bsam gyis mi khyab til gyi gang bu bzhin bskor te bzhugs pa las/ de rnams kyi gdug rtsub kha rlangs las nad rnams 'byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nad dang mtshon chas brlags la khad pa las/ 'khor gyi nang nas mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje dhe ma zhes bya yis rang gi stan las lang nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad gsol to/ /e ma ho bcom ldan dbang chen rgyal/ /gdug sems dregs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /srid pa gsum po brlag byed na/ /thugs rje'i bdag pos 'dul ba'i dus la babs bka' non mdzod/ /ces bskul nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /rang rig ye shes don gyi ye shes ma shar bsam/ /ma rig nyon mongs rang snang log pa'i 'khrul pa'i rgyu/ /sa bon srid pa'i rtsub mo'i sems kyi 'phangs/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i gdug sems can/ /drag po sngags kyis bdag dbang 'dud/ hriḥpad+ma tsan+da mahā kro dha ha ya gh+ri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pas dregs pa can thams cad dred cing dngangs ste zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi snying po bsdus te tshigs su bcad pa ni 'di ltar/ mthu ldan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /khyod ni sngon tshe 'og min chen po ru/ /zhe sdang me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /rak+ta chags pa'i rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus/

/dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po nyid/ /khams gsum dbang 'dud ting 'dzin nyid la zhugs/ /de tshe dug lnga chos nyid ngang rol ba'i/ /bdud dang dmu dang btsan dang rgyal po dang / /gying dang gnod sbyin mthu ldan grangs med dang / /stobs ldan rtsal drag ldan pa khyod kyang 'dus/ /de ltar rta mgrin dregs pa'i 'khor rnams kyi/ /gdug rtsub kha rlangs mthu yis nad mtshon gyis/ /bskal pa'i 'jig rten stong par nye ba'i tshe/ /rta mgrin 'khor gyi khrod nas mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdo rje pad+mas khro dbang rgyal po la/ /gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan rta mgrin gyis/ /gtum po'i rtsa sngags 'brug ltar bsgrags pa las/ /'khor gyi dregs pa thams cad 'dar zhing dngangs/ /de tshe dregs byed kun dang gnod sbyin gtso/ /rtsi dmar khyod la bcom ldan rta mgrin gyis/ /dbang bskur dam tshig phog nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa srung bar khas blangs dam bcas shing / /dus der bcom ldan dbang gi rgyal po yis/ /gnod sbyin spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud/ /legs par gsungs pa de nyid mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdo rje pad+ma zhes byas bka' bsdu ba/ /mdzad de sra brtan rdo rje'i brag la sbas/ /e ma rgyal ba'i thugs kyi ye shes nyid/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir 'jig rten dregs pa'i gtso/ /gnod sbyin rtsal drag ldan pa'i tshul bzung ba/ /'di la dpyod ldan su zhig som nyi za/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de dag gi ni thog mar yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas chos skyong chen po 'di nyid kyi rgyud spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud gsungs shing bstan pa'i srung mar bka' bsgos shing zhal gyis bzhes pa'i tshul rnams bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rgya gar me 'bar gyi dur khrod du/

slar yang dam tshig phog cing rgyud kyang gter nas gzhes te bka' srung du mnga' gsol ba'i tshul ni/ de yang sngon gyi dus rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gnas/ gnya' ri dmar nag zur gsum gyi mdun/ srin mtsho khol ma me lce ris kyi 'gram na/ brag dmar po srin po lang pa 'dra ba cig yod do/ /gnas de la slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub gnas mdzad de/ gsang sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu dgongs pa mdzad kyin bzhugs pa las dus cig gi tshe nam gyi srod la babs pa na gnod sbyin rtse dmar gyi sprul pa/ spyang khyi chen po khrag gi ral pa can bdun byung ste/ de dag ngu zhing slob dpon la bar du gcod pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs byed du byung ba na/ slob dpon gyis dpal rta mgrin gyi ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs te/ phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje 'phyar zhing sdigs par mdzad pas/ sngar gyi spyang khyi bdun po de rta pa bdun du gyur nas/ slob dpon la phyag 'tshal zhing bzod gsol byed du byung ngo / /de'i tshe slob dpon gyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod su yin ming la ci zer gsungs pa la/ bdag ni gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rtse dmar bya ba lags/ bdag sngon dpal rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur zhing dam tshig gis phog nas bstan pa'i srung mar khas blangs pa lags so/ /bdag gi ming ni rgya gar na gnod sbyin rtse dmar zhes grags shing / bod yul na mthu ldan lha btsan zhes zer ba lags zhes zhu ba la/ yang slob dpon gyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyi gnas gang yin/ pha dang ma dang srog gi snying po gang yin smros shig zhes gsungs pa la/ bdag gi gnas ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul 'di nyid lags so/ der ma zad gtsang gi gsang phug bya ba de yang lags/ pha ni dmu rje chen po legs pa zhes bya ba de lags shing ma ni btsan gyi rje chen po zla ba thod dkar gyi bu mo gnod sbyin zangs 'dren ma zhes bya ba lags/

srog gi snying po ni sngon bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyis gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud ces bya ba le'u bdun gyi bdag nyid can mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje pad+mas bka' bsdu ba mdzad pa de'i nang na yod pa/ sngon ston pa bzhugs pa'i dus rgyud de bse'i ga'u sen gang pa gcig gi nang du bcug nas brag ri dmar po srin po lang pa 'dra ba 'di'i brag ser ga can gyi nang na gter du sbas nas yod pas rgyud de nyid slob dpon gyis gter nas bzhes te/ de nas bshad pa'i man ngag rnams la longs spyod par mdzod cig bdag gi sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma bgyi'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa na/ slob dpon rab tu dges te ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang rgyas par bskur bar mdzad nas gsang mtshan btags pa ni kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyi spu gri dmar po snying gi rgyud le'u bdun gyi bdag nyid can gter nas bzhes te gnod sbyin rgyal po 'di nyid slob dpon gyi chos skyong ba'i srung mar mdzad cing mnga' gsol lo/ /dus phyis sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ gnod sbyin gyi sprul pa rta pa bdun gyis mnga' ris dpal thang nas bsus te/ bsam yas su ma phebs kyi bar du bskyel bsu la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen gyi 'phrin las cher bsgrubs pa na/ slob dpon dges pa'i gsung las/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rtse dmar gnas pa'i yul de ni nges par sa phyogs 'di nyid na yod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon gyis gnod sbyin gyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs man ngag rnams ches shin tu gnyan pas su la yang ma gnang par/ gtsang sra gtum gyi rgyal po spyan mi bzang gi mgul du sba bar mdzad do/ /phyis rab mnga' ris kyi ston pa zla ba rdo rjes gter gyi kha byang brnyed nas bton pas/

stod gzer dang shang khrag zhag dgu byung nas grong la khad pa la tshogs 'khor rgya chen po btang zhing / thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga mang du byas pas snyung ba gdangs so/ /de nas slob dpon zla ba rdo rjes shog ser de dkar bzhag nas zhal bshus mdzad nas 'ong pa la/ rgod ma dmar mo gcig ja gsig gnyis/ dar chos cig phul nas dbon po drung las zhus pa sogs las brgyud do/ /lo rgyus de dag ni kho bo cag rang lo nyer gsum lon pa'i dus dbus phyogs la gnas mjal la phyin skabs gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud kyi dpe rnying bsam yas na yod pa de nyid chos skyong rang gi cho 'phrul gyis lag tu rtsol med du byung ba de nyid kyi mjug na ji ltar yod pa bzhin bkod pa yin pas rigs dang chos kyi bu la sogs pa blo gros dang ldan pa'i rjes 'jug rnams yid gnyis dang bral bar mdzod cig de rnams kyi snying po bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni 'di ltar/ bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /rgya gar dur khrod chen po me 'bar gyi/ /gnya' ri dmar nag zur gsum rngam pa'i mdun/ /srin mtsho khol ma me lce ris kyi 'gram/ /brag dmar srin po lang 'dra'i sgrub gnas su/ /slob dpon chen pos rtse gcig sgrub la 'khol/ /de tshe dus cig tshe na srod kyi char/ /spyang khyi khrag gi ral can bdun byung ste/ /de dag ngu zhing pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gnod par brtsams tshe slob dpon chen po yis/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i ting 'dzin rab brtan pas/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar bas gcan gzan rnams/ /rta mchog bzhon pa'i skyes bu bdun gyur te/ /slob dpon nyid la bzod gsol phyag btsal nas/ /bdag ni gnod sbyin rgyal po rtse dmar te/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan khro rgyal rta mgrin gyis/ /dbang bskur dam tshig phog nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs de nyid yin/

/rgya gar yul du gnod sbyin rtsi dmar zhes/ /yongs la grags shing bod yul gangs khrod na/ /mthu ldan lha btsan zhes su 'bod de mchis/ /de ltar gsol te pad+ma'i bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyi gnas dang srog snying gang yin smros/ /slar yang gnod sbyin rgyal pos 'di skad gsol/ /bdag gi gnas ni 'phags yul 'di nyid dang / /gtsang gi gsang phug bya ba de yang lags/ /pha ni dmu rje legs pa zhes bya dang / /ma ni btsan rje zla ba thod dkar gyi/ /bu mo gnod sbyin zangs 'dren ma zhes bya/ /srog gi snying po sngon tshe rta mgrin gyis/ /dam btags tshe na gsungs pa'i bka' dri med/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje pad+mas bsdus mdzad pa'i/ /rgyud chung gang de brag ri chen po 'di'i/ /stod phyogs brag ri srub ldan 'di yi nang / /bse las byas pa'i ga 'u sen gang pa/ /de na yod kyi longs spyod mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma bgyid/ /de ltar gsol bas pad 'byung rab dges te/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur nas/ /gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /zhes btags rgyud kyang gter nas spyan drangs te/ /gnod sbyin khyod nyid slob dpon srung mar mdzad/ /de nas gu ru pad+ma bod yul du/ /byon pa'i dus su glog ltar myur ba yi/ /rta mchog bzhon pa'i skyes bu bdun dag gis/ /mnga' ris dpal thang nas bsus bsam yas kyi/ /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / /'gran zla bral ba'i gnas mchog de nyid bar/ /bskyel dang bsu ba'i 'phrin las cher bsgrubs pas/ /slob dpon dges pa'i gsung las gnod sbyin gyi/ /rgyal po rtsi dmar gnas pa'i yul de ni/ /gnas mchog de na nges par yod ces gsungs/ /de ltar mkhyen dang brtse dang nus pa'i tshogs/ /ston mchog zas gtsang sras dang dbyer med pa'i/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' yi srung ma mchog /'di la blo ldan su zhig dad mi byed/

/bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de dag gi ni bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rgya gar me 'bar gyi dur khrod du slar yang dam tshig gis phog cing rgyud kyang gter nas bzhes te bka' srung du mnga' gsol ba'i tshul rnams bstan zin nas/ gsum pa tha mar rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma la bha ta hor gyi bsgom grwa nas spyan drangs shing / slob dpon chen po'i bka' bzhin gtsug lag khang gi skor srung mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ de yang chos kyi rgyal po khri srong gis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dus der rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la/ nga'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma chos skyong gcig dgos pa 'dug cing / bstan pa srung ba'i mnan gtad gzer gsum la sogs pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams kyang dgos par 'dug dgongs nas/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po mdzad nas zhus pa/ e ma hoḥ slob dpon chen po bka' drin can/ /lnga brgya'i tha ma phyi phugs su/ /bdag 'dra rgyal po chos rgyal mi 'byung zhing / /blon po gdug cing 'bangs rnams sil bur 'gro /dbus gtsang ru bzhi tha 'dul gyi/ /gtsug lag khang gi srung ma gang gis bgyi/ /bstan srung thog ser gtad la sogs/ /sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung ba gang la bgyi/ /slob dpon thugs rjes bzung nas gnang bar zhu/ /zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis bka' stsal pa/ e ma ho/ dus kyang je ngan je ngan 'gro/ /rje'i thugs dam bsam yas kyang / /rgyal po'i snying du 'gong po 'jug /'bangs rnams nang 'thab dme 'khrug byed/ /gtsug lag khang la 'thab khang 'cha'/ /sgyogs dang me dong 'jig pa 'ong / /dbus dang mtha' 'dul skor rnams ni/ /mi nag rnams kyis spyod par 'gyur/ /chos 'khor mda' phug dod par byed/ /chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig par byed/

/sngags pa gri ru gsod par byed/ /rgyal po'i shul gyis lam mi thub/ /chos gos 'og tu gri thung 'dzugs/ /che btsan dug gis gsod par byed/ /skye bo nang 'thab mtshon gyis gsod/ /sngags pa nang rgyas mthu 'gran byed/ /gong ga cher dam byed pa dang / /gso kha phyi sgo srung ba dang / pha phad nang dme byed pa dang / /mtshon gyi bskal pa dar bar 'ong / /chos byed btsun par mi byed cing / /zog po bslu brid mkhan la rtsi/ /gos ngan khyi yi thul pa gyon/ /zha ngan rtsid pa'i 'be zhu gon/ /mtshon ngan dbyug pa 'khyer ba dang / /chos ngan chad lta'i stong nyid ston/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /de tshe gtsug lag skor srung pa/ /skor srung rgyal po spe dkar dgos/ /bha ta hor gyi bsgom grwa nas/ /ska cha'i phyir ni 'phrang nas 'ong / /de tshe nga yi skor srung bcol/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal pos bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs grub pa dang / lha khang tha dad la srung ma re re yod kyang / gtsug lag khang spyi'i skor srung la chos skyong chen po 'di nyid spyan drangs pa'i tshul ni/ de yang slob dpon gyi bka' bzhin rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sras lha sras mu khri btsan po dgung lo nyi shu tsam lon pa'i dus su/ byang phyogs kyi dmag dpon la bskos nas gtong ba'i tshe/ u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / mkhan po bo dhi satwa dang / slob dpon bi ma la mi tra/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shi la dang / gu ru'i thugs kyi sras brgyad/ bla mchod brgya lnga bcu rnams bsam yas dbu rtse chen po'i bar khang du gdan drangs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ bar khang gi rnga khang gi mdos dang gtor tshogs chen po bsham nas/ mu tig btsan po'i yab dang / bla mchod rnams la 'di skad ces gsol ba btab nas zhus so/ /bdag byang phyogs su kha'i yul khams/ khri dan brgya dang / phyogs thams cad du dmag dpon la bskos nas gtong par gda' bas/

bdag dang dmag sde thams cad la tshe srog la bar chad med pa dang / phyogs kyi so kha thams cad thul nas/ yab rgyal po'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i thabs dang / phyogs thams cad du bkra shis dang dge legs chen po 'byung ba'i rten 'brel rgya chen po gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ yab rgyal pos thog drangs pa'i der tshogs pa thams cad kyis/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba btab nas zhus pa/ kye slob dpon chen po lags/ rgyal bu 'di'i gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du thugs kyis dgongs nas byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhus so/ /de nas slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rgyal po yab sras kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par bya ba'i don du 'di ltar bya'o/ /gsungs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong bar byed pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dang / 'khor gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad dang / las tshogs sgrub par byed pa'i mgo brnyan sna tshogs yod pa'i gnod sbyin gyi tshogs nam mkha' gang ba dang bcas pa sprin gyi gseb tu spyan drangs/ rgyal po yab sras 'khor dang bcas pa la zhal mngon sum du bstan/ lha ma srin sde brgyad la sogs pa snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyi srog dam la btags nas/ rgyal bu 'di'i phyir lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ bdag gis ji ltar bsgos pa bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod cig ces bka' bsgos so/ /de'i dus su sprul pa'i lha bzo mtha' yi mgon btsun zhes bya bas/ rgyal po yab sras kyis ji ltar gzigs pa bzhin du 'phyar dar chen po zhig la ri mor bris so/ /de nas slob dpon pad+ma la sogs pa bla mchod rnams kyis rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor bcas dngos su mnga' gsol nas/ rgyal bu'i thugs dgongs ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin du thams cad bsgrub par khas blangs/
