rgyal po'i bla dar mdzad par dam la btags so/ /de nas yab rgyal pos phyogs thams cad la pho nya btang / zla ba dang tshes grangs gi dus tshigs bor te/ mnga' 'og gi dmag thams cad bsdus te/ khams kyi g.yer mo thang du 'tshogs shig ces dus byas so/ /de nas rje mu khri btsan pos me sgyogs dang chu sgyogs la sogs pa'i dmag chas te g.yar mo thang du byon nas/ nang blon chen po zhang lha bzang klu dpal gyis gtso byas dmag thams cad 'tshogs pa'i dus der/ rgya zam chen po gcig gi gam du lcags phag gi de'u brtsigs te de'i steng du rgyal bu bzhugs/ gong gi bla dar chen po de 'phyar/ nang blon chen po de rnams kyis rgya zam de la dmag shar nas grangs la btab pa'i dus su/ shar phyogs bya khra'i rgyal khams kyi dmag yin zer ba/ lus po mi la mgo bo bya khra'i gdong pa yod pa/ dar re'i shul la khri tsho re 'drongs pa dar tsho dgu byung / lho phyogs grul bum rkang rtse'i rgyal khams kyi dmag yin zer ba ro stod mi la rta bong gi rkang sug yod pa/ dar re'i khri tsho re 'drongs pa dar tsho bcu byung / nub phyogs byi bla mjug ma can gyi rgyal khams kyi dmag yin zer ba/ mi'i lus la byi bla'i mjug ma yod pa/ gcer bu ko ba'i phub khur ba/ lag tu smyug bshags kyi mdung thogs pa/ dar tsho re'i khri tsho re 'drongs pa dar tsho bcu gnyis byung / byang phyogs rna bo che bong bu'i rgyal khams nas yongs pa yin zer ba lus mi la rna ba bong bur yod pa/ dar re'i phyir khri tsho re 'drongs pa dar tsho bcu gsum byung / de rnams mthong ba'i dus su rgyal bus bzhad mo shor bas/ nang blon chen po zhang lha bzang klu dpal gyis gtso byas pa'i dmag rnams na re/ rten 'brel shin tu bzang / dgra thams cad thul nas 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas gru khu dang rgya nag gi rgyal khams thams cad bcom/ hor gyi bsgom grwa bar la bcom nas/

ba sa'i lha khang dang / shing dung dkar po rgyang grags dang / cha lang dang / dre rngog la sogs pa skor chas thams cad khyer/ rgyal po spe dkar gyi sku dang / shel gyi seng ge dang / sbal pa la sogs pa rin po che'i spyad pa rgyal po chags pa'i rten rnams dang / 'chams sku bse 'bag dmar po gdan drangs/ dmag rdzas chen po dang bcas rgyal bu yar byon pa'i dus su dmag dpon rnams kyi nang nas nang blon chen po lha bzang klu dpal dmag sde dang bcas pa khri bstan 'dul ba la bskos so/ /rgyal bus yar byon te phyag rdzas rnams yab rgyal po la phul lo/ /de nas dgung lo sum cu so lnga la mching phu brag dmar gye'u gong du slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i spyan sngar sdig pa thams cad bshags/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang dang man ngag gi ngo sprod zhus te nyams su blangs pa las/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal gzigs/ rgyal po yab sras kyi thugs dgongs mthar phyin nas rgyal khams bde ba la bkod/ de ltar bha ta hor gyi bsgom grwa nas khyer ba'i gong du bshad pa ltar gyi ska cha rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i tshul gyis chos skyong chen po 'di nyid dpal bsam yas su byon pa yin te/ 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ kha che'i slob dpon bi ma la mi tras gsol ba'i mtshan rgyal po stag mgo can zhes kyang bya/ bal po'i slob dpon hūm̐ ka ras gsol ba'i mtshan ser chags yongs kyi dgra lha zhes kyang bya/ rgya nag gi slob dpon mahā ya nas gsol ba'i mtshan bdud rje btsan po zhes kyang bya/ hor yul gyi slob dpon lha rje 'od dkar gyis gsol ba'i mtshan rgyal po shing cha can zhes kyang bya/ gzhan yang bdud ma zher nag po zhes kyang bya/ gnod spyin gyi rgyal po rtse'u dmar po zhes kyang bya/ rgyal po chen po spe dkar zhes kyang bya ste/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa dpa' bo stag chas brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa nyan thos dgra bcom pa brgya/

slad kyi rjes gnon ban+de nag po brgya/ sngon gyi shul 'dren bud med nag mo brgya/ phyi'i blon po ka ha ra brgya/ nang gi blon po mon bu pu tra brgya/ sku'i skyo sang gar 'bag seng ge brgya/ sprul pa'i yang sprul spre'u byi bla brgya la sogs pa 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa/ dkor rdzas dang lha rten rnams kyi phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas byung ba la/ de nas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis spe dkar skor mdzod gling du rten btsugs te dam la btags nas dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang spyi dang / gzhan yang mtha' 'dul dang / yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi skor srung du bka' bsgos shing dam la bzhag pa bzhin chos skyong yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dis kyang zhal gyi bzhes pa yin no/ /dus der slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bka' gnang nas/ lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na dang / snub nam mkha'i snying po dang / sba ye shes dbang po sogs kyis phyis rab bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon char dmigs nas lha ma srin sde brgyad las/ dkar po gying / nag po bdud/ dmar po btsan/ srog gcod gnod sbyin/ gshan pa srin po/ nad gtong ma mo/ drag po gza'/ gdug pa klu de rnams kyi sgrub thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bsgyur ro/ /khyad par bstan pa spyi'i srung ma dpal mgon po nag po dang / dpal lha mo nag mo dang / sngags srung nag smug rnam gsum gyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs du ma dang / lha ma srin gyi sna 'dren/ gying rdo rje legs pa'i rgyud sgrub thabs sogs dang / steng nam mkha' la dbang byed pa'i gza' gdong la rten nas chu 'khyags/ ser ba/ gnam lcags thog 'bebs pa sogs dang / mgo nag la dbang byed pa'i klu bdud la rten pa'i las tshogs mdze nad sna tshogs btang ba'i gtad khram/ de la sogs pa'i drag sngags bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bsgyur nas/ slob dpon chen pos rgyal po la snyigs dus bstan pa bsrung ba'i lag char gtad do/

/de nas mnga' bdag rgyal po rab tu dgyes nas rta chibs pa tshal bu bya gdong gi sna drangs pa'i rgyal pos 'og rta drug la gser srab g.yu thur/ seng ldang sga khra/ za 'og gi hor gdan pho long ris su bris pa/ gser sil ma bre gang / g.yu bre gang / rje'i mgul g.yu mtsho ro 'od 'bar sogs slob dpon la phul nas phyag mang du btsal zhing / slob dpon gyis kyang rgyal po'i thugs rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po thob pa'i phyir ka cha rnams bzhes pa'i tshul mdzad nas slob dpon dges par gyur te/ rgyal po blon 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad dga' spro'i dpal la rtag tu longs spyod par gyur to/ /de dag gi snying po bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni 'di ltar/ /ut+pal sngo ldan sprul pa chos rgyal ches/ /rlabs chen thugs bskyed las grub gtsug lag khang / /gang gi srung ma 'gran zla bral ba zhig /thugs kyi bzhed tshe slob dpon chen por zhus/ /de tshe dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa yi/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas gsung bzhin hor yul gyi/ /sgom grwa chen po'i gnas nas bstan srung khyod/ /spyan drangs bsam yas mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gi gsung las/ da lta bsam yas zer ba dang / zab yangs zer ba ma dag zan g.yangs mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba dag ste/ de yang zan zhes pa gsum dang / g.yangs zhes pa lugs kyi ming ste/ rgya nag gi skad yin pas/ dbu rtse rigs gsum lugs bsam yas mi 'gyur ba lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes pa'i don yin/ zhes bris snang yang brtag par bya'o/ lhun gyis grub par byon/ /dus der mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam yas pa'i/ /slob dpon chen pos spe dkar skor mdzod kyi/ /gling du bka' srung khyed kyi rten btsugs nas/ /gtsug lag khang chen rnams kyi srung mar bskos/ /de nas bzung ste gangs can khrod 'di ru/ /stobs ldan 'byung po sa 'og sa bla dang /

/sa steng rgyu ba'i 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs/ /kun la dbang bsgyur rgyal por yongs su grags/ /bo dhi satwa gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i gar/ /phyis dus 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ /gtsug lag zung gis bsam yas brkyangs pa'i tshe'ang / /'phrin las mgon po zhes su bsngags zhes thos/ /khyad par phyi rab bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog /bstan 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /gtsug lag khang chen rnams kyi nyams gso dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i chos grwa gsar 'dzugs sogs/ /bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad tshe yang / /stobs ldan gnod sbyin khyod kyi 'phrin las kyis/ /rnam 'phrul du mas bstan 'dzin bstan par bcas/ /'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad ces yongs la grags/ /sngags 'chang de sras bdag gi 'dren pa mchog /pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang po dang / /zhi ba 'tsho nyid slar byon grags pa'i mtshan/ /de ltar 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs 'dzin pa'i/ /skyes mchog mched la'ang mthu ldan gnod sbyin khyod/ /rtag tu 'phrin las sgrub la bran bzhin gyur/ /des na dang po bcom ldan rta mgrin dang / /bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs/ /tha mar 'khon ston sa skya'i rje btsun mchog /rim par byon pa rnams dang khyad par du/ /'gran bral sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang rje/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /gang bcol las rnams thogs med bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /'phrin las mgon po che khyod bsngags par 'os/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de dag gis ni tha mar rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma la bha ta hor gyi bsgom grwa nas spyan drangs shing / slob dpon chen po'i bka' bzhin gtsug lag khang gi skor srung mdzad pa'i tshul bstan zin nas/

de yan gyis bye brag bka' srung mchog gi byon tshul bshad pa la gnyis kyi dang po gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud dang de'i man ngag zab mo byung tshul gyi yi ge rnying ma nas 'byung ba bzhin bshad pa bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa rgyal po shel phreng dkar po'i rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i man ngag gi rgyud rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ rtsa rgyud las 'byung tshul bshad pa dang / bshad rgyud las 'byung tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ gnas gang du gdul bya ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / 'dul byed gang gis btul zhing lha'i dge bsnyen chen po'am/ chos skyong chen po 'di nyid kyi skye rgyud bstan pa dang gnyis las/ dang po ni sngon 'das pa'i dus na dur khrod chen po li mu zhes bya ba'i gnas na/ dregs pa'i tshogs thams cad 'dus par gyur to/ /de yang za byed nag po pe ra dang / su ma ki dang / sma sha ri dang / kasma shrī dang / sma sha ni dang / tsaṇ+ḍa li dang / sing nga ma dang / 'dzin sgrol ma dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / dres bzhon ma dang / shugs 'gro ma dang / phung byed ma la sogs pa srid pa'i ma mo'i tshogs du ma dang / gzhan yang 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs ni/ mahā de ba mgon nag dang / gshin rje'i tshogs dang / ra hu la dang / bdud kyi rgyal po chen po dang / lha'i dge bsnyen shel phreng dang / yum dmar mo dang / yab rje dang / yab bzhed mgon po the rang gi tshogs la sogs pa dregs byed kyi tshogs kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa tsam du 'dus nas stobs ldan gyi 'byung po de rnams kyis glo bur du sems can gyi srog gcod cing sha khrag rlon pa bza' zhing 'thung pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang mthu rtsal sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas thog dang ser ba 'bebs pa/ mi nad sna tshogs btang te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad phung bar byas pa yin no/ /de skad du/ rgyal po shel phreng gi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u las/

dur khrod chen po li 'du zhes/ /dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun 'dus te/ /za byed nag po pe ra dang / /su ma ki dang sma sha li/ /kasma shrī dang sma sha ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li dang sing nga ma/ /'dzin sgrol ma dang rdo rje ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang shugs 'gro ma/ /dre bzhon ma dang phung byed ma/ /srid pa'i ma tshogs kun 'dus pa'o/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /mahā de ba mgon nag dang / /gshin rje'i tshogs dang ra hu la/ /bdud kyi rgyal po chen po dang / /srid pa'i lha 'dre gdug pa can/ /lha yi dge bsnyen shel phreng dang / /yum dmar mo dang yab rje dang / /yab bzhed mgon po the rang tshogs/ /glo bur srog gcod sha khrag rlon du za/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu rtsal sna tshogs byed/ /thog ser mi nad sna tshogs gtong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnyis pa 'dul byed gang gis btul zhing / lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'am/ chos skyong chen po 'di nyid kyi skye rgyud bstan pa ni/ de ltar 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs de rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ gong gi dur khrod chen po li 'du zhes bya ba de nyid du rgyal ba rnams kyi bka' bgros shing 'phrin las gcig tu bsdus nas sprul pa ni/ tsher ma can gyi shing dang / dug gi shing me tog dang bcas pa mang po dang / gcan gzan ma rung pa du ma dang / dur bya'i tshogs rab tu mang pos bskor ba'i dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / khrag gi rba rlabs rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das pad+ma khrag 'thung 'jigs su rung ba/ gtum drag 'bar ba'i sku bzhengs te/ mi mthun pa'i tshogs sna tshogs 'dul ba'i don du cho 'phrul chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te sprul pa'i khro tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spros shing / de'i nang nas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la'ang drag tu bskul te ha ha dang / hi hi dang / a la la la sogs pa 'jig pa'i sgra skad dang / tsham ngam dpa' brtul gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yo bar mdzad do/

/de'i tshe dur khrod li 'du na gnas shing 'khod pa'i 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs de rnams la la brgyal/ la la khrag skyugs/ la la skad ngan 'don zhing thams cad zil gyis mnan te skyabs 'tshol bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes 'jig rten lha srin gyi tshogs la bka' stsal pa ni/ khyed rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma he ru ka'i bka' bzhin bsgrub na rang rang gi srog snying 'bul ba dang / so so'i sgrub thabs dang / mthun pa'i dam rdzas gang la gang dga' ba dang / dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi ji ltar bya ba dang / rang rang gi las skal gang yin pa sogs smros shig ces bskul ba dang / dregs pa can gyi tshogs rnams kyi nang nas lha'i dge bsnyen chen po'am/ chos skyong chen po 'di nyid kyis/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma he ru ka dang / gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la gong gi dri ba'i lan rnams so so dang / khyad par dregs byed so so'i skye ba snga ma'i las kyi lus tha dad du grub tshul dang / de'i nang nas dge bsnyen chen po rang nyid kyi mes yab ni/ ri rab kyi rtse dpag bsam shing gi rtsa ba na/ bdud mkhar rtse dgu'i nang / mi ro rta ro'i khri steng na bzhugs pa'i bdud kyi rgyal po ra dza rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / yum ni ri rab kyi byang shar/ dpag bsam shing gi rtsa ba na mtsho ma dros pa zhes bya ba'i nang na klu mo dkar mo mgo cog can zhes bya ba'i yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/ de yang bdud dang klu mo gnyis phan tshun chags pa'i 'phrin bsrings shing / phan tshun lhan cig tu rol ba las/ klu mo la ri rab kyi rtser zla ba lnga nas sgo nga bcu gsum skyes te/ sgo nga rnams la me 'bar ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su sgra dang / mun nag 'thib pa sogs byung bas klu mo rngam ste sgo nga rnams slar rang gis zos pa'i tshe de ma thag klu mo rang nyid kyi lus la me 'bar ba dang /

sna nas glog 'khyug pa dang / mig nas khrag 'dzag pa dang / lus kyang 'jig pas snyam byed pa byung ba'i tshe ri rab rtser phyin nas/ bdud kyi drung du sgo nga rnams skyugs nas gsang bdag phyag rdor la phul te/ 'di rnams kyi nang nas ma rung ba 'byung bas byin gyis rlobs cig par gsol ba na/ gsang bdag gis kyang rdo a mo li kha'i steng du sgo nga rnams bzhag ste rdol ba mdzad pa las/ de dag gi nang nas rim pa bzhin/ rgyal po skos rjes brang dkar dang / gza' bdud ra hu la dang / mgon po mu kha zung gnyis gdong can dang / shar phyogs shel gying dkar po dang / dregs pa dgu dbang che dang / pad+ma gar dbang dang / tshangs pa dung gi khong seng can dang / sog po lcags kyi sma ra can dang / ye kha 'khrul gyi rgyal po dang / srid pa gzhi 'dzin nor gyi bdag po dang / ya shud dmar po la sogs pa rim par byung zhing / sgo nga bdun tshigs pa de nam mkha' la 'phur ba las/ phyag rdor gyis ded cing zin nas rdol ba na lha'i dge bsnyen chen po'am/ chos skyong chen po nyid byung ste/ de yang gzhan las ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan rtags mang po dang ldan pa zhig byung bas/ mtshan yang spe dkar rgyal por btags shing / dus der mi'i lus la mgo bo bya khyung du byung bas/ brgya byin gyis lha'i dge bsnyen khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul du btags shing / lha ma yin gyi yul du dmag drangs te lha ma yin rnams pham par byas pa'i dus su lha'i dge bsnyen chen por grags pa dang / gzhan yang rang gi ming gi rnam grangs dang / 'khor dang blon po la sogs pa ji ltar yod pa'i tshul rnams rgyas par zhus nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa yin te/ de ltar yang rgyal po shel phreng dkar po'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u las/ rgya gar skad du/ ru tra rā dza bha bhi tan+t+ra ghu h+ya na maḥ bod skad du/ bdud rgyal shel phreng gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba bcom ldan 'das 'jig byed khrag 'thung gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'di skad bdag gi thos pa'i dus cig na bcom ldan 'das pad+ma khrag 'thung 'jigs su rung ba gtum rngam drag pos 'bar ba'i skur ston pa/ nga rgyal gyis bdud dpung zil gyis gnon pa/ ha ha dang hi hi'i gad rgyang sgrogs pa/ sku la dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs pa/ dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs pa/ /rtsi shing nags tshal tsher ma'i shing / /me tog nag po dug shing sogs/ /gcan gzan tshogs ni rab tu 'khrug /dur bya'i tshogs ni rab tu sgrogs/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /khrag gi rba klong rab tu 'khrug /zhes dang / yang rgyud de nyid las/ de lta bu yi gnas dag tu/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /mi mthun sna tshogs 'dul don du/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang / /sprul pa'i khro tshogs nam mkha' bkang / /gsang ba'i bdag po la yang bskul/ /ha ha hi hi a la la/ /tsham rngam dpa' brtul 'jig rten g.yo/ /dregs pa can rnams rab tu brgyal/ /kha nas khrag skyug zil gyis gnon/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung chen po yis/ /dbugs phyung ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ /dregs pa can rnams brgyal bsad do/ /skad ngan 'don pa skyabs 'tshol lo/ /bdag cag dpal gyis bka' stsal nyan/ /ci bgyi zhes ni bka' bsgo mdzod/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dpal gyi bka' bzhin byed pa na/ /rang rang lugs ni ji ltar sgrub/ /srog gi snying po gang nas drangs/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas gang la dgyes/ /dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi ji ltar bya/ /rang rang las rnams gang la dga'/ /bka' bzhin byed na tshur smros shig /dregs pa can gyi tshogs nang nas/ /lha mi dge bsnyen chen po yis/ /bcom ldan pad+ma khros pa dang / /'khor gyi gsang bdag chen po la/ /bdag cag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /skye ba snga ma'i las dbang gis/ /ma bsgrub srog gcod las su skyes/

/de rnams nang nas bdag lus ni/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo nas/ /dpag bsam shing gi rtsa ba na/ /bdud mkhar rtse dgu'i nang shed na/ /mi ro rta ro'i khri steng na/ /bdud kyi rgyal po rā dza rgyal ba bzhugs/ /ri rab byang shar zom shed na/ /dpag bsam shing gi rtsa ba na/ /ma dros mtsho yi nang shed na/ /klu mo dkar mo mgo cog can/ /klu chen brgyad kyi lcam cig ma/ /sa bdag gnyan gyi phyi mo mdzad/ /lus la 'dod chags chu ltar khol/ /srid pa gsum na khyo ma brnyed/ /yid kyi gdung ste gnas pa la/ /yab gcig bdud kyi rgyal po yis/ /bdud nag po 'dzum med la 'phrin brdzangs nas/ klu mo la srid pa'i mdza' nang byas na mi rung ngam/ klu mo'i zhal nas/ srid pa'i mdza' nang bya ba nga yang dga' ste/ nga 'dod chags che/ khyod zhe sdang che/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gnyis 'tshogs pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong par byed pa'i gnod sbyin mang po 'ong na ji gtsug byed/ de skad ces gus pas 'phrin brdzangs so/ /yang bdud kyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten stong yang 'dod ste/ de stong pa nga yi las yin/ bdud klu mo gnyis ri rab kyi zom rtse la srid pa bshos pa las/ zla ba lnga na sgo nga bcu gsum skyes/ /sgo nga 'gul ldog me ru 'bar ba las/ /'jig rten khams su sgra dang mun nag 'thib/ /yum klu mo rngams te sgo nga rnams slar khong du mid do/ /mid ma khad de la rang gi lus las me 'bar/ kha nas khrag byung / sna nas glog byung / mig nas mchi ma khrag gi char du babs/ lus kyang 'jig pa snyam byed pa/ ri rab kyi rtse mo tshangs pa lha'i gnas su bdud thod phreng can gyi spyan sngar phyin te/ sgo nga de dag skyugs nas dpal phyag na rdo rje la phul te/ sgo nga 'di rnams nas gnod sbyin gdug pa ma rung ba yong bas/ byin gyis brlab cing 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ phyag na rdo rjes sgo nga de rnams khyer nas tshangs pa lha'i gnas su rdo a mo li ka'i steng du bzhag ste/

rdo re re 'phang zhing rdol ba las/ sgo nga dang po nas bdud kyi rgyal po bskos rjes brang dkar byung / sgo nga de'i 'og ma rdol ba la gza' bdud ra hu la byung / de'i 'og ma rdol bas mgon po mu kha zung gnyis gdong can byung / de'i 'og ma nas shar phyogs shel ging dkar po byung / de'i 'og ma nas dregs pa dgu dbang che byung / de'i 'og ma nas pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug byung / de'i 'og ma nas tshangs pa dung gi khong seng can byung / de'i 'og ma nas sog po lcags kyi sma ra can byung / de'i 'og ma nas ye kha 'phrul gyi rgyal po byung / de'i 'og ma nas srid pa gzhi 'dzin nor gyi bdag po byung / de'i 'og ma nas yar shu dmar po byung ngo / bdun tshigs pa de gnam du yar ba las/ dpal phyag na rdo rje thugs khros te ded pas zin/ sa la lan gsum brdab nas phyag rgyab pas sgo nga gas pa'i nang nas bdud kyi bu mi 'dra ba lha'i sras po 'dra ba cig byung ngo / /sku gzugs ni dkar la che ba/ dbu la gling bzhi ri rab kyi dpe 'dra bas brgyan pa/ lus la rgyal rtags bcu gsum tshang ba ngo mtshar ba gcig byung nas/ ya mtshan skyes te mtshan yang spe dkar rgyal por btags so/ /de ma thag tu lus po mi'i lus po la/ mgo bo bya khyung gi mgo bo byung nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i dge bsnyen khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul du btags so/ /lha ma yin la dmag 'dren pa'i dus/ chibs su seng ge dkar po chibs/ sku la dar dkar gyi ral ga gsol/ dbu la gling zhu sngon po gsol ba/ phyag na spu gri bskor zhing phyin pas dus su lha ma yin gyi dmag bcom pas lha'i dge bsnyen chen por btags so/ /lha'i yul du grags pa'i dus su lha'i bsam gtan bsrung du bcug pas/ bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin du zhugs pa'i tshe/ dge bsnyen nag po dun ring har du btags so/ /de lta'i dus na mtshan mang po lags te/

gang nas bos kyang lha'i dge bsnyen bdag lags so/ /bdag gi yab ni bdud/ yum ni klu bdud gza' smin dkar mo lags so/ /'khor ni stong dpon chen po dang / dmag dpon chen po dang / srog bdag nag po dang / ral pa nag po dang / dar nag chen po lags so/ /phyi'i blon po ha ra dang / lang dra dang / nang gi blon po pu tra rdo rje dbang / khol po 'dzin pa dang / sdom po dang / g.yas kyi mda' ra ba/ dpa' bo stag chas brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa nyan thos dgra bcom brgya/ sngon gyi shul sel bud med nag mo brgya/ slad kyi rjes nyul ba ban+de nag po brgya/ phyag brnyan bzung ba la wa khyung spun bzhi dang 'di rnams skyes pa'i lus dang / sprul pa'i ming ni de lags so/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams bka' bzhin bgyid do/ shel phreng dkar po'i rgyud las gleng gzhi dang gleng blang ba skye rgyud kyi le'u ste dang po'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de dag gis ni rgyal po shel phreng gi rtsa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi nas 'byung tshul bshad pa bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa shel phreng dkar po'i bshad rgyud nas 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ de yang bshad rgyud de nyid kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u nas 'byung ba'i don rnams kyi snying po bsdus nas brjod na sngon 'das pa'i dus su/ yab bdud rje btsan po dang / ma klu gza' smin dkar ma gnyis la srid pa'i sras mched lnga byung ba'i lnga tshigs su dge bsnyen chen po'am/ chos skyong chen po 'di byung ngo / /de nas gnam gyi yab la gung gi yang steng na bzhugs pa la/ sus kyang klag ma brnyed cing dbang du ma 'dus pa la/ gnam nas yas babs kyi tshul du byis pa lo brgyad pa cig gi rnam par sprul nas bha ta hor gyi yul/ bsam 'grub shel gyi brag phug na slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha wa chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don rtogs shing bzhugs pa la/ ting nge 'dzin las gsad pa'i bar mtshams zhig na/

gnod sbyin chen po 'dis seng ge dkar mo zhig tu byas nas/ slob dpon la nyams tshad blangs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khyi tshugs ma byas nas/ kha dang mig gnyis gdeng / rna ba gzhung te/ slob dpon gyi steng du mchongs la khad 'dug pa la/ gu ru pad+ma nyid mngon par mkhyen pa mnga' bas gnod sbyin gyi bu mthu bo che zhig yin par thugs kyis mkhyen nas/ dbang chen gyi ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs nas kha ṭ+waṃ ga rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bcas nas brgyab pas/ seng ge dkar mo gnam du bros te song bas/ ban+de nag po gcig tu byas nas gnam rdo dkar po lug tsam zhig thog gi tshul du phab byung ba/ slob dpon gyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu phog pa na/ re zhig ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag ste/ de las bzhengs nas gu ru pad+ma nyid kyis dbang chen gyi ting nge 'dzin du zhugs nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bkug pas/ dge bsnyen gzhon nu cig tu byas nas lag na shel phreng brgya rtsa brgyad pa cig thogs nas slob dpon gyi drung du byung bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ gnod sbyin gyi bu la dge bsnyen gyi tshul ston pa khyod su yin gsungs pa la/ dge bsnyen na re/ /bdag bdud kyi bu la klu yi tsha ste/ bdud kyi bu la dam tshig bsre nus sam zer/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ dam tshig bsres na bka'i bstan pa ma nub bar du bsrung nus sam mi nus gsungs pa la/ gnod sbyin na re/ dam tshig bsres nas bdag gis bstan pa ma nub bar du bsrung nus so zhes zhus te/ de nas slob dpon gyis khyung gshog gi phyag rgyas dbang du bsdus pas/ dge bsnyen chen po des dam btags srog gi snying po phul ba la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rā dza tsit+ta zung / kha rag rma sha rbad rbad/ khu na dum bur bshig /'das na rak+ṣa tsit+ta phyung rbad/ ldog na rak+ṣa myogs rbad rbad tri gtum/ ces slob dpon la phul lo/ /slob dpon gyi thugs kyi nying khu nas gsang ba'i bcud btol nas/

lag tu rdo rje gtad/ lce la a mri ta bzhag nas gsang ba'i dam la ni btags/ mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni byin/ dbang rnam pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin gyi rlabs lnga yang bskur nas/ de nas slob dpon la slob bu dge bsnyen gyi gdung ba'i dbyangs blangs nas rin po che'i phreng ba der phul te/ chos kyi dbyings dang sbyor ba'i shel phreng dkar po 'di/ /bdud kyi bur skyes dge sdig don ma rtogs/ /dge sdig don rtogs lha dang bla ma la/ /rig pa'i me tog 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /ces brjod cing me tog phul lo/ /de nas slob dpon gyis kyang rigs dang sbyar te gsang mtshan btags pa ni/ rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul zhes bya bar btags so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis phyag rgya rnam pa drug gi dbang bskur ba mdzad de/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bcings nas/ chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha' gnyis su med/ /de ring phan chad skal ldan khyod nyid la/ /chos kyi rigs kyi phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ /chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don rtogs shog /zhes pas phyag rgya'i dbang dang po dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ /rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes dbang thob shog /zhes pas phyag rgya'i dbang gnyis pa dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ /rin chen rigs kyi phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dbang thob shog /zhes pa phyag rgya'i dbang gsum pa dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ pad+ma rigs kyi phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dbang thob shog /zhes pa phyag rgya'i dbang bzhi pa dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ /las kyi rigs kyi phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes dbang thob shog /zhes pas phyag rgya'i dbang lnga pa dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/

/thugs rje skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog /zhes pas phyag rgya'i dbang drug phyag rgya so so dang bcas rim pa bzhin dbang bskur ba mdzad nas/ de nas yang rgyal po nus mthu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ phyag mtshan rnam pa lnga'i dbang bskur bar mdzad pa ni/ thog mar stag gi rgyal mtshan gtad de/ de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ /stag gi rgyal mtshan dag gis dbang bskur bas/ /stag gis gcan gzan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa ltar/ /rgyal po khyed kyis 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang thob shog /zhes pa phyag mtshan dang po'i dbang dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ /spre 'u'i rgyal mtshan chen pos dbang bskur bas/ /ha nu ma des spre 'u thams cad 'dul ba ltar/ /rgyal po khyod kyis dgra rnams 'dul bar shog /zhes pas phyag mtshan gnyis pa'i dbang dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ /bya rgod rgyal mtshan chen pos dbang bskur bas/ /bya rgod 'dab chags zil gyis gnon pa ltar/ /rgyal po khyod kyis dgra rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang thob shog /zhes pas phyag mtshan gsum pa'i dbang dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ /spyang khu'i rgyal mtshan chen pos dbang bskur bas/ /spyang khus gcan gzan thams cad zil gyi gnon pa ltar/ /rgyal po khyod kyis dgra rnams zil gyi gnon pa'i dbang thob shog /zhes pas phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i dbang dang / de ring phyin chad skal ldan bu khyod la/ /za 'og rgyal mtshan chen pos dbang bskur bas/ /rgyal po khyod kyi longs spyod dang ni mthun par shog /zhes phyag mtshan lnga'i dbang rnams rim par bzhin bskur bar mdzad de/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dge bsnyen chen po byin gyis rlabs nas/ der slob dpon dang dge bsnyen gnyis slob dpon dang slob bur gyur pa yin no/ /de rnams ni rgyal po shel phreng dkar po'i man ngag gi bshad rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u las 'byung ba'i don rnams snying po bsdus nas bris pa yin la/

de nas chos skyong chen po 'di nyid bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du byon pa'i tshul ni gong du bshad pa ltar sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan yab sras kyis bha ta hor gyi bsgom grwa bcom nas dngos spyad rnams khyer ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i tshul gyis rgyal po pe ha ra 'khor bcas bsam yas su lhags pa na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis spe dkar gling du byon nas spe dkar gyi sku rnams bzhengs shing / chos skyong 'di'i phyi rten du srog chags dkar po dang / nang rten du smyug rgod la dar sna tshogs btags pa dang / rnga ma sna tshogs btags pa dang / gsang rten du sku 'bag dang mdos la sogs pa btsugs nas srung ma byed par bka' bsgos shing khas blangs so/ /de rnams kyis shel phreng dkar po'i bshad rgyud las 'byung tshul bstan pa ste de yan gyis bye brag bka' srung mchog gi byon tshul bshad pa la gnyis yod pa'i phyi ma rgyal po shel phreng dkar po'i rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i man ngag gi rgyud rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul ma lus pa bshad zin to/ /de dag gis ni dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bka' srung dang bcas pa'i byon tshul legs par bshad pa chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu dges par byed pa'i yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba las bka' srung mchog gi byon tshul bshad pa'i skabs ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa de las 'phros pa'i skabs su babs pa'i don gzhan bstan pa ni/ de yang 'o skol gyi ston pa zas gtsang sras po'i bstan pa lung gi dus kyi mjug 'dir skye bo ngan pa phal cher rnams gsung rab kyi don la rtog dpyod dang bral bas/ chos gang la yang rmongs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur kyang / slob dpon blun po 'ga' zhig gi ngag bgros kyi rjes su 'brangs nas don med ri bong cal rgyugs kyi rtog dpyod la rem pa'i skye bo hu re long mang po zhig 'di skad du/

/da lta'i bsam yas chos skyong chen po 'di ni/ 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i rgyal 'gong gdug pa can zhig yin pas/ 'dis gnod pa bsrung ba la/ chos nyid zab mo'i lta ba'i go yul tsam yod pa dang / drag sngags cung zad bgrangs pa'i yus po che 'ga' zhig dang / rgyal po'i sgrib shing la sogs pa'i srung ba sna tshogs dang / bon pa'i rgyal mdos dang / bgegs gtor gtong ba sogs kyi bzlog par sems shing / slob dpon chen pos bsam yas sa 'dul mdzad dus btul ba'i rgyal 'gong spe dkar de yang / chos skyong chen po 'di yin no zhes smra zhing rnam dpyod dang bral ba'i skye bo phal cher de'i rjes su rgyug pa mthong mod/ de dag ni shin tu ma brtags pa chen po ste/ spyir chos skyong chen po 'di 'jig rten dregs byed kun gyi gtso bo yin pas de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i rgyal btsan sogs kyi gnod pa la gong gi rkyen bzlog de dag gis phan par srid mod/ chos skyong chen po rang nyid ni nges don la yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig gis bsdus kyang gdul bya gzhan gyi ngor/ dus ngan snyigs ma mthar thug pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing skyong ba la/ rtsal drag dang ldan pa gzhan las kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa'i 'jig rten dregs byed kun gyi gtso bo gnod sbyin mthu bo che'i tshul gyi skur bstan par nges te/ de skad du/ rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ re 'ga' zhi la re 'ga' khro/ /re 'ga' bgegs chen don mdzad cing / /zhes pa dang / rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las kyang / gang su snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /seng ger snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /chang 'tshong ma dang smad 'tshong mar snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pas mtshon nas zhing khams dag pa la lar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo/

la lar ni 'khor/ la lar ni bsdu pa po la sogs pa'i snang brnyan dang / la lar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i sangs rgyas dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang / grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa dang / a wa dhu ti dang / bhu su ku dang / ku sa li dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i rgyal po dang / khams kyi rgyal phran dang / blon po dang / bram ze dang / dge sbyongs dang / khyim bdag dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / gru gzings dang / zam pa dang / sman dang / zas dang / gos dang / ri bo dang / bya dang / ri dwags la sogs pa/ mdor na snod bcud kyi rnam pa thams cad pa 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyi rnam rol du mas 'gro ba rnams rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i spyod pa dang gtam gyi mtshams sbyar te/ mthar nges par zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sar dkri bar mdzad pa kho na las mi 'da' bar gsungs pa las/ chos skyong yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di ni 'jig rten dregs pa'i gtso bo gnod sbyin mthu bo che'i sku sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin par nges la/ de bzhin tu gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud mang po las kyang / don la ye shes pa la rnam pa bdud btsan rgyal po sogs 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba mang du 'byung bar gsungs ba'i don/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa bklags pa don 'grub kyi gzhung las kyang byin dbab kyi skabs su/ gying chen ka ra'i lha tshogs byin rlabs can/ /zhes pa dang / sman mchod kyi skabs su/ gying chen bco brgyad gying phran 'bum sde la/ /zhes gsungs pa yang don 'di dag la dgongs pa yin te sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i/ rin chen rtse ba'i gnyer pa'i dris lan las/ gying ka ra zhes pa ni 'og gi sman mchod kyi skabs na/ gying chen bco brgyad gying phran 'bum sde la/ /zhes pa dang don gcig btsan bdud rgyal po sogs 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung pa rnams yin la/

'di dag ngos 'dzin rnying ma'i yig cha rgya che ba rnams su gsal/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas so/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i 'byung po rnams ni ji ltar stobs che yang / rang rang gi smon lam sogs kyi 'phen pa rdzogs pa na/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs kyi rkyen la brten nas lus ngan de bor te tshe'i dus byed pa chos nyid yin la/ chos skyong chen po kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal 'di nyid ni gong du rgyas par bshad pa ltar/ thog mar bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma he ru ka gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje sogs kyi ye shes kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing / de rjes slob dpon chen pos dbang dang gsang mtshan phog nas rang gi srung mar mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang bal po'i slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra dang / kha che'i slob dpon bi ma la mi tra sogs grub thob rigs 'dzin rtsod med du mas bka' srung du mdzad cing / bod gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang sngon byon pa'i lo chen skyes mchog du ma zhig gis srung mar bsten zhing bsngags pa chen po mdzad pa la brten nas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dgon rnying dregs pa can phal cher na chos skyong 'di srung ma la 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin zhing / khyad par mkhan po bo dhi satwa nyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / dpal bsam yas nyams pa gso ba la bsam bzhin du byon pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas bzung / snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po yab sras kyi bar du byon pa'i sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud 'khrul pa'i dri ma dang bral ba thams cad kyi gsung las kyang / bsam yas chos skyong chen po 'di/ sa skya pa'i 'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra dmar po yin zhes mgrin gcig tu bka' stsol bar mdzad pa dang /

mdor na chos skyong chen po 'di nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du bstan pa/ bstan 'dzin/ gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa'i skor srung mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs par yongs su grags shing mngon sum du grub pa 'dis phyir/ des na thog mar 'byung por skyes pa nas bzung lo grangs 'ga' zhig gam/ mi rabs 'ga' shas sogs nas tshe 'phos nas 'gro ba'i 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i lha 'dre rnams dang chos skyong 'di 'dra bar sems pa ni blun pa bas kyang ches blun pa'i mthar thug par shes par bya'o/ /'o na ye shes pa yin na gang zag so skye'i rtsa sbug du 'byon pa mi rigs so snyam na/ de ni nges pa med de/ don la ye shes pa la/ rnam pa 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba'i dregs pa can mang po zhig de lta bu'i snang tshul ston pa mang du 'byung ba dang / lhag par rang re rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srung dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma dang thugs rgyud cig pa'i lha mo dud sol ma yang sngon gyi dus su gang zag 'ga' zhig la lung bstan pa stsal ba'i tshe/ de dus kyi log rtog can 'ga' zhig gis ngan smra ci yang zhig bgyis pa de'i tshe dus mtshungs mkhas pa dag gis 'di skad du/ ye shes kyi lha mi la mi 'bab/ /'bab pa 'di dag 'jig rten pa'o/ /zhes smra ba ni shin tu mi 'thad pa ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rdo rje shugs phab nas de la dge mi dge dri ba dang / slar gshegs su gsol ba bshad cing / gzhan yang rgyud sde nas rdo rje sems dpa' 'bebs pa'am/ ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga bshad pa thams cad don med par 'gyur bas so/ /zhes bshad 'dug pa ni shin tu 'thad par mngon te zhing skyong gi dbang po dur khrod kyi bdag po yang / gang zag phal pa'i rtsa sbug du byon nas sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog gi 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzad pa ste/ de yang rje rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma la lan cig gsol ja cung zad dkon pa zhig gi tshe/

/nye gnas kong po ngor la gsol ja bsgrub du 'gro khar/ rje rdo ring pa chen pos zhal bkur gyi tshul du/ dur khrod bdag po la kho'i 'da' la rgyug la ja khug shog gsungs pas/ nye gnas dpon g.yog tshos ngor dgon pa'i mda'i ja pa zhig gi nang du gnas tshang g.yar ba'i tshe/ de pa'i g.yog zhig la zhing skyong dur khrod bdag po babs nas/ ja dgos tshul smras pas/ tshong pa rnams la rtog pa skyes nas/ gsol ja shin tu dngos gtsang ba ston nas tshong 'bul byas pa byung zhes/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rje rdo ring pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba zhes bya ba las 'byung zhing / gzhan yang dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo nyid kyang gang zag phal pa la 'byon pa'i tshul yang gong du bshad pa de dag dang mtshungs la/ des na ye shes pa mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi mnga' bdag rnams kyis sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs su ston pa la/ rang re so so skye bo rnams kyis 'di tsam mo zhes tshod bzung bar ga la nus de'i phyir rgyu mtshan med bzhin du/ ye shes pa so so skye bo la 'bab par mi rigs so/ /zhes smra ba de dag gi zhal ni me tog ku mu ta nyi ma'i zer reg pa ltar byas na rang nyid la mdzes pa yin no/ /gzhan yang slob dpon chen pos bsam yas sa 'dul gyi tshe btul ba'i rgyal 'gong spe dkar de chos skyong 'di yin par 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/ chos skyong chen po 'di ni slob dpon rin po che rgya gar nas bod du byon pa'i sngon nyid du rang gi bka' srung du mdzad zin pa yin la/ bsam yas kyi 'gong po spe dkar de ni bsam yas sa 'dul gyi rjes nyid du 'dul bar mdzad pa'i tshul gong du rgyas par bshad pa ltar yin pas so/ /de ltar na chos skyong chen po 'di'i mtshan la rgyal po spe dkar zhes 'jig rten na grags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam snyam na/

de'i tshul ni/ rgya gar gyi skad du/ bi ha ra zhes pa/ bod skad du/ gtsug lag khang pa zhes pa ste/ sgra de'i zur chag pa las/ spe dkar dang / spe har du song ba yin zhes skad zur chag gi rnam gzhag bshad pa'i gsung rab rnams las 'byung bas na/ des na chos skyong 'di'i mtshan la rgyal po spe dkar zhes 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'jig rten dregs byed kun gyi gtso bo yin pas rgyal po dang / slob dpon chen pos gtsug lag khang gi srung mar bskos pas na gtsug lag khang gi ming rgya skad de nyid/ de'i srung ma'i mtshan du thogs pa yin par shes par byos shig skabs 'dir chos skyong chen po 'di'i gsang ba'i rten zhal 'bag 'phi ra smug chung du grags pa 'di'i lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ de yang chos skyong chen po rang nyid kyi zhal 'bag gi byung tshul gsung shog tu gnang ba las/ bha na ku sha 'o ma'i mtsho gling du/ /pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ /ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /lho nub srin po 'dul bar bsngags/ /dur khrod bsil ba tshal zhes su/ /srin po'i bam ro ri ltar spungs/ /bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor/ /chos skyong 'du ba'i ri rab ltar/ /dmar mo sha yi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ /tshil chen dud pa'i spos ngad ldan/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i bdud rtsir mchod/ /gu ru pad+ma bzhugs su gsol/ /sde brgyad bran ltar 'khol ba'i mnga' gsol lo/ /bar snang sprin nag tshogs pa'i me lce 'bar ba 'dus/ /khrag thig gsum gyi thigs pa lan gsum babs/ /sa gzhi skyang ser rlung gi 'tshub mo che bar lang / /srin po'i ngos kyi gzhi ma rlung gis bskyal/ /rgyu rnams de la grub pa'i gu ru'i phyag na bzo/ /dmar nag gnyis kyi dbye ba rang bzhin grub/ /ming yang bar snang 'phi ra'i lus su btags/ /phyin pa bha ta hor gyi yul du phyin/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' bzhin bsgrub/

/zab yangs rdo rje gdan du babs pa bzhin/ /steng 'og bar gsum sde brgyad 'tshogs pa'i dpon du bskos/ /gzugs med gzugs can rnams kyis lha ru bsgom la mchod pa phul/ /lha mchog chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rnams rang gi go tshod tsam brjod na/ de yang sngon slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgya gar dur khrod sil ba'i tshal du srin po'i sha khrag gi bam ro'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ bar snang nas sprin nag rab tu g.yos te me drag tu 'bar ba dang bcas/ sprin gseb nas khrag gi thigs pa chen po gsum babs pa na/ sa gzhi las kyang rlung dmar drag tu lang zhing g.yos par gyur to/ /nam mkha' nas babs pa'i khrag thig gsum po de srin po'i bam ro'i sha khrag rus gsum dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa la rgyu byas/ slob dpon rin po che'i phyag bzo mdzad de/ deng sang bsam yas spe dkar na yod pa'i zhal 'bag smug chung 'di dang / dpal sa skya'i nang so pu tra khang na bzhugs pa'i zhal 'bag smug chung 'di gnyis dus cig tu grub cing / slob dpon gyis phyag gnas mdzad pa na/ pu tra dmar nag gnyis ka sku 'bag so so la dngos su thim zhing / chos skyong so so dang byin rlabs nus pa mnyam par gyur pa las/ nam zhig dus la babs pa na/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas sku 'bag gnyis ka bar snang la 'phur te gshegs pa las/ bsam yas chos skyong chen po'i sku 'bag de nyid bha ta hor yul gyi bsgom grar babs pa las/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la bsgom grwa bcom nas dngos spyad rnams bsam yas su 'khyer ba'i tshe/ zhal 'bag 'di yang de dag dang mthun par bsam yas su byon pa'i tshul ni gong du bkod pa'i chos skyong rang nyid kyi gsung las kyang gsal bar thon pa de yin la/ bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan srung bka'i las byed rnams kyi gtso bo'i mchog tu gyur pa dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra chen po'i zhal 'bag smug chung du grags pa da lta dpal sa skya'i nang so pu tra khang na bzhugs pa 'di ni rgya gar nas 'phur te re zhig bha ta hor yul gyi bsgom grar bzhugs pa las/

phyis rab chos rje khu dbon tsam gyi sku ring la phyag tu byung ba de nyid gdan sa chen po 'dir spyan 'dren par mdzad par yin nam snyam du kho bo sems so/ /de dag las 'phros te/ nges pa'i don du zhi ba'i lha rgyal ba rigs lnga nyid/ drang don du drag po'i lha rgyal po chen po sku lnga la sogs pa byung ba'i tshul dang / da lta spe dkar lcog na bzhugs pa'i sku 'dras chen mo grags pa'i 'chams sku 'di nyid dang / chos skyong chen po 'di nyid sku phebs byung res bzhin gsol ba'i dbu rmog dang / sdig khrab tu grags pa'i rgyu bse las grub pa la bse'i byang bu re re la yang btsan bye ba 'bum sde re re gnas par bshad pa'i gsol khrab bse khrab khyad par can de nyid la sogs pa 'di thams cad kyang slob dpon rin po che'i phyag bzo 'khrul med yin pa'i tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus ngo mtshar can mang du 'byung yang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros la/ shes par 'dod na ngag las 'byung ngo / de ltar 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing mchog tu gyur pa'i dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid la thog mar bka' drin che ba la mkhan slob rnam pa gnyis dang chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan chos blon lo paṇa khyad par can dang bcas pa rnams dang / bar du bka' drin che ba mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i rnam par sprul pa 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan slob tshogs yon bdag chos kyi rgyal po dang bcas pa rnams dang / tha mar bka' drin che ba snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po yab sras sa skyong sbyin bdag dang bcas pa rnams te/ skyes bu dam pa de dag gi spyir ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar so so dang / bye brag dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid la srid zhu zhabs tog rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshul sogs rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa mtha' dag rtogs par 'dod na/

rgyal rabs sogs yig tshang rnying ma rnams dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ karma byams chos pa sogs kyis mdzad pa rnams dang / kho bos byas pa'i sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar rgyas pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho dang / 'bring po yid 'phrog lha'i ljon shing / bsdus pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng ba sogs/ sngags 'chang yab sras so so'i rnam thar rnams la blta bar gyis shig dang / sngon byon pa'i sprul pa'i skyes bu mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi mnga' bdag de rnams la dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa dbang med du skyes nas rang rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po thob par 'gyur ba ni chos nyid do/ /de dag gi ni bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bka' srung dang bcas pa'i byon tshul legs par bshad pa chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu dges par byed pa'i yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba las de las 'phros pa'i skabs su babs pa'i don gzhan bstan pa'i skabs ste gsum pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ 'phags yul paṇa chen byang sems zhi ba mtsho/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /sprul pa'i chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la/ /bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyi 'o/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir zas gtsang sras kyi bstan/ /phyogs re 'dzin pa'i dam pa mang byon yang / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal srid skyong ba la/ /sa skya pa zhes 'di na yongs la grags/ /de dag yab sras khu dbon brgyud bcas kyis/ /bde gshegs bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum la/ /gcig tu gzhol bas byang phyogs rgyud 'di na/ /skyes chen de dag thub pa'i rgyal tshab lags/ /da lta'i rmad byung bstan pa rin chen rgyun/ /phyogs dus kun du 'phel zhing rgyas pa las/ /ljongs 'dir bstan pa 'dzin par khas che ba/ kun mkhyen dol po/

rje kun dga' grol mchog sogs jo nang pa snga phyi/ bo dong pa/ dge ldan pa/ shangs pa bka' brgyud dgas po bka' brgyud kyi brgyud 'dzin 'brug pa snga phyi/ 'bri stag karma pa sogs/ /kun kyang brgyud 'dzin slob bur ma gyur med/ /phyi dus yid bsrub stobs ldan 'ga' yis rgyus/ /sa skya'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin dgon gnas bcas/ /cung zad nyams tshe de nyid gso ba'i phyir/ /sngags 'chang sprul pa'i skyes mchog yab sras byon/ /e ma dam pa de dag bka' drin las/ /gangs can 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas 'di ngo mtshar gnas/ /sngon byon gong ma'i mdzad bzang glang chen khur/ /nyams chung be'us phrag par lhung ba ltar/ /dam pa snga ma'i mdzad bzang rgyun skyong ba'i/ /'khur 'di'i bdag gi lus sems mnar bar gyur/ /de lta na yang bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin kun 'grub ste/ /bstan pa rab rgyas srid mthar 'dzin par smon/ /de lta'i lhag bsam zla ltar dkar ba yi/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /gsung rab don la spyod pa'i blo gros can/ /gang des bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /ngo mtshar gtsug lag khang chen bka' srung bcas/ /byon tshul gsal bar bshad pa'i bstan bcos 'di/ /bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pas sbyar/ /'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag gdul byar bcas/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun grub ste/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can bgrod shog /gzhan yang bdag gi rigs brgyud dri med kyis/ /rgyun chad med par bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / /gangs ri'i ljongs 'di ma lus sa skya pa'i/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyun gyis khyab par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang /

/yi dam zhi khro rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / /bka' srung dam can rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis/ /yid la bsam pa'i don rnams kun 'grub shog /ces dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bka' srung dang bcas pa'i byon tshul legs par bshad pa chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu dges par byed pa'i yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di yang 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras zhi ba mtsho'i rnam sprul yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spro bsdu'i byed po dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang nas/ de'i bka' srung gi gtso bo gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po rtse'u dmar po'am mtshan gzhan sa skya pa'i 'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra dmar po bsam yas chos skyong chen po zhes grags shing / gsang ba'i mtshan ni kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal nyid kyis 'di lta bu'i yig cha zhig rtsom zhig ces gsungs 'phrin gyi bkas bskul ba dang lhan cig par mkhan tshang rab 'byams pa bsod nams dbang phyug gis kyang nan chen pos bskul ma byas pa la rten nas bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar rgyal rab so so rnams dang / gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud cha lag dang bcas pa rnams dang / rgyal po shel phreng dkar po'i rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud la sogs pa gong du smos pa'i yig cha de dag gzhir byas pa lacung zad mi gsal ba rnams bla ma mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun khyad par can rnams kyis brgyan cing rang gi blo gros kyi zhib tu dpyad pa'i legs bshad kyis kyang mdzes par byas te/

rgya gar lugs la shrī mu kha ste/ dpal gdong zhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la chu mo bya yi lo sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen po bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod rab tu gsal ba'i blo gros dang ldan pas gso ba rig pa la mkhas shing / yi ge'i 'du byed la sbyang ba phul du phyin pa'i gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen gyis gus spro'i sgo nas mgyogs par bgyis so/ /'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid la re ba bzhin 'bad med lhun grub tu gyur nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ thams cad bkra shis/ ka r+ya na wa dhan+tu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 62 a myes zhabs/ dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen po bka' srung dang bcas pa'i byon tshul legs par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 63
